normal.speak: tacit expertise may compensate for gaps in the instructions
normal.vocabId: R8:TACIT EXPERTISE MAY COMPENSATE FOR GAPS IN THE INSTRUCTIONS

normal.desc: 請拼出：規定應如何行動而非只描述的（P 開頭，12 個字母）
請拼出：釐清有多種解讀的意思（D 開頭，12 個字母）
請拼出：明確表達原本隱含的想法或要求（A 開頭，10 個字母）
填空題：P R E R E Q _ I S I T E (使後續事情可行所需的先決條件)
填空題：P R _ V _ S O (附於許可或協議上的限制條件)
填空題：S U _ F I _ I E _ C Y (足以達成某條件或目的的性質)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 看似完全倒塌而無法辨認的後牆
B. 帶明確歡迎訊息的每面牆
C. 只在室內可見的裝飾隔板
D. 使人望而卻步的建物正面
normal.explain: forbidding 是令人畏縮，不必物理危險。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 預設某種條件而使部分人被排除的想法
B. 已逐一確認每人需求的開放程序
C. 完全沒有任何背景假設的觀察
D. 為了計算總數而刪除重複紀錄
normal.explain: exclusionary 暗示排除效果，presumption 為預設。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 明說專為阻止某人而設的規則
B. 表面中立的進入門檻
C. 已證實不影響任何人的條件
D. 只有門口地板高度的精確數值
normal.explain: ostensibly 為表面聲稱，未必實質中立；threshold 可比喻。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The discretion of the assistance point is welcome until discretion becomes indistinguishable from invisibility.
options: A. 協助點低調本是優點，但低調到找不到就成問題。
B. 協助點越難看見越好，因服務不需任何人發現。
C. 說話者抱怨協助員沒有決策權，與位置可見性無關。
D. 協助點已完全透明公開，所以不可能帶來隱私。
normal.explain: discretion 低調保密的優點需與可發現性權衡。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The map naturalises the institution’s categories by presenting them as though they were the categories in which a visitor’s problem must already be understood.
options: A. 說話者只反對地圖使用自然景物作為部門名稱。
B. 地圖把機構分類當理所當然，彷彿遊客問題本來就得依此理解。
C. 地圖先依遊客問題分類，再逐項解釋對應機構。
D. 機構分類已由所有遊客共同投票決定，所以無需再解釋。
normal.explain: 自然化分類預設，非地圖必然逐字不正確。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The welcome is unconditional in its wording and curiously exacting in the knowledge it expects visitors to bring.
options: A. 措辭已詳細解釋全部知識，所以沒有任何隱性要求。
B. 說話者確認所有遊客都具備相同完整知識。
C. 歡迎措辭無條件，卻對遊客先備知識要求很高。
D. 歡迎要求很少先備知識，卻明列嚴格身份限制。
normal.explain: 宣告無條件與知識隱性門檻可衝突。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The apparent universality is achieved by treating the needs left out of the design as exceptional rather than as evidence about the design’s limits.
options: A. 說話者只要求把圖上的例外標成不同顏色。
B. 表面普遍靠把未涵蓋需求稱為例外，而非承認設計有界限。
C. 設計逐一涵蓋所有需求，因此例外需求已不再存在。
D. 使用者需求被證明只能有一種，所以普遍性已成立。
normal.explain: 以例外名義保護普遍主張，未直接證每項需求都應同法處理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The system’s defenders describe abandoned attempts as a lack of interest, thereby excluding from their evidence the very encounters that might challenge its ease of use.
options: A. 辯護者把放棄計入困難，因此低估系統的操作效率。
B. 說話者認為任何放棄都只能由系統故障造成。
C. 辯護者把放棄當沒興趣，因而排除可能挑戰易用性的經驗。
D. 放棄者全已親口確認沒興趣，所以不需再了解使用困難。
normal.explain: 放棄原因未明卻預先排除困難解釋，may 保留非唯一。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What is advertised as independence may require a degree of prior competence the advertised experience is supposed to help a person acquire.
options: A. 活動已完整教會先備能力，所以獨立使用無需任何前提。
B. 說話者反對讓任何人學會獨立使用公共設施。
C. 先備能力只在活動結束後才有用，與進入流程無關。
D. 宣稱獨立使用，可能先要求活動本應幫人取得的能力。
normal.explain: 先備能力與培養目標形成循環依賴，非否定獨立目標。

normal.desc: 【語意】The building is permeable in plan but forbidding in demeanour. What contrast is made?
options: A. Its exterior is inviting but its plans prohibit every entrance.
B. Its open spaces have been permanently closed by a new rule.
C. Its appearance reveals every internal route without requiring a plan.
D. Its layout permits entry while its appearance discourages it.
normal.explain: permeable 可穿透進入，demeanour 比喻建物表情氣質令人卻步。

normal.desc: 【文法】The difficulty lies not in the route itself but in knowing ___ of the identical doors marks its beginning.
options: A. which
B. that
C. whose
D. what it
normal.explain: which of doors 表從相同門中選哪一個。

normal.desc: 【語用】The entrance is open to all who know it is an entrance, observes the critic of an unmarked side door. What is exposed?
options: A. The door’s location proves that no person has ever entered through it.
B. Formal openness depends on unequal access to practical knowledge.
C. The entrance has been officially restricted to a named group of residents.
D. The critic believes side doors should never be used as entrances.
normal.explain: 形式人人可入卻需先知道隱含資訊，非正式名單限制。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The instructions are intelligible once decoded into the visitor’s terms. What remains unresolved?
options: A. Who performs the translation the visitor needs in order to use them.
B. Whether visitors are permitted to read instructions in the building.
C. Whether the instructions contain any official department names.
D. Who printed the signs and selected the colour of their lettering.
normal.explain: once decoded 留著解碼負擔分配，非已適合初訪者。

normal.desc: 【語意】The design mistakes the absence of a prohibition for the presence of an invitation. What is criticised?
options: A. It makes an invitation conditional on paying an unspecified admission fee.
B. It treats not being barred as equivalent to feeling encouraged to enter.
C. It treats a clear invitation as though it were an enforceable prohibition.
D. It assumes every visitor will disregard an explicitly written restriction.
normal.explain: 沒被禁止不等於被邀請的感受，語意對照明確。

normal.desc: 【文法】So insistently ___ familiarity that a newcomer’s confusion is made to look like a personal failing.
options: A. presume does the layout
B. the layout presumes does
C. does the layout presume
D. the layout does presume
normal.explain: So insistently 前置引 does 主詞原形倒裝。

normal.desc: 【立場】The essay questions the universal visitor implied by the design rather than the possibility of shared facilities. What is challenged?
options: A. A requirement that every facility be duplicated for each individual.
B. An assumed user whose needs and knowledge stand in for everyone’s.
C. The idea that different users may ever enter the same building.
D. The existence of any needs held in common by more than one person.
normal.explain: 批評預設某一種使用者為普遍，非反對共享本身。

normal.desc: 【短文】The building provides a discreet assistance desk, but locating it requires passing through the very interaction visitors may need help to undertake. What problem is present?
options: A. Visitors have been offered too many equivalent desks at the same entrance.
B. The assistance requires advance booking because its staff have different schedules.
C. The route to assistance presupposes the ability that assistance is intended to support.
D. The desk’s existence proves that every interaction in the building is optional.
normal.explain: 取得協助先需具備待協助能力，為循環門檻。

normal.desc: 【語用】The guide describes the route as self-explanatory to anyone who has used it before. What weakens the claim?
options: A. The route has been redesigned too recently for anyone to know it.
B. A person who used the route before cannot remember its location.
C. The guide is explicitly asking first-time visitors to explain the route.
D. Previous familiarity is doing the explanatory work attributed to the route.
normal.explain: self explanatory 卻靠先用過知識，對初訪可用性未證。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：難以理解或看透的
請唸出單字：具有排除某些人效果或目的的
請唸出：被默默優先考量的起點
請唸出：預設使用者已有所需能力
請唸出：形式開放可能與實際排除並存
normal.ans: FORMAL OPENNESS MAY COEXIST WITH PRACTICAL EXCLUSION
normal.speak: formal openness may coexist with practical exclusion
normal.vocabId: R8:FORMAL OPENNESS MAY COEXIST WITH PRACTICAL EXCLUSION

normal.desc: 請唸出：可被發現的替代方案須讓新手看見
normal.ans: A DISCOVERABLE ALTERNATIVE MUST BE VISIBLE TO UNFAMILIAR USERS
normal.speak: a discoverable alternative must be visible to unfamiliar users
normal.vocabId: R8:A DISCOVERABLE ALTERNATIVE MUST BE VISIBLE TO UNFAMILIAR USERS

normal.desc: 請拼出：允許穿透或進入的（P 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：外觀或氣氛令人畏縮的（F 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：內容可被理解的程度（I 開頭，15 個字母）
填空題：D E M E _ N O U R (外顯態度或舉止，亦可比喻氣質)
填空題：D I S C O _ E R A B _ L I T Y (某選項或資訊容易被發現的程度)
填空題：I M _ E D _ M _ N T (阻礙某事進行的因素)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 做作而過度戲劇化的情緒爆發
B. 平靜而不外露的私下反應
C. 完全沒有觀眾的每段獨白
D. 因忘詞而未能發出的句子
normal.explain: histrionic 指誇大演出式情緒，含負評。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 按時間列出的每項換景安排
B. 令人驟然注意的舞台定格畫面
C. 由警察完成的拘捕報告
D. 因燈未亮而完全看不見的場景
normal.explain: arresting 引人注意，tableau 如畫面般的場景構圖。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 尚未有人感到任何情緒的開場
B. 為了延長演出而加上的說明文字
C. 由前面鋪陳支撐而有說服力的情緒宣洩
D. 只因音量變大而自動成立的情緒效果
normal.explain: earned 指劇情/表演鋪陳使效果成立，catharsis 情緒釋放。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The actor lets the character discover the insult a moment after the audience, and that fraction of delay changes the scene.
options: A. 演員因忘記侮辱台詞，所以觀眾從未聽到。
B. 角色比觀眾晚一瞬才察覺侮辱，這細微延遲改變場景。
C. 角色先察覺侮辱，再向觀眾明說每個字的意思。
D. 觀眾與角色同時理解，因此場景毫無知覺落差。
normal.explain: 觀眾/角色理解時差形成戲劇效果，非忘詞。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The virtuosity is undeniable, but one occasionally wishes the production trusted an ordinary gesture to carry an extraordinary amount of feeling.
options: A. 說話者要求每種深情都配更複雜而顯眼的技巧。
B. 普通動作已被逐一刪掉，這是評論者最欣賞之處。
C. 技巧無可否認，但有時希望作品信任普通動作也能承載深情。
D. 作品完全沒有技巧，所以只能靠平凡動作填滿場景。
normal.explain: 肯定技巧並期望節制，不否認精彩。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Her stillness is not a refusal to act but a refusal to announce every shift in the character’s attention.
options: A. 她因拒絕扮演角色，所以停止所有舞台行動。
B. 角色完全沒有注意力變化，因此演員無事可做。
C. 說話者認為表演必須每秒作明顯動作才能被理解。
D. 她的靜止不是不表演，而是不把每次注意力變化都張揚出來。
normal.explain: 外在靜止可有內在行動，非技術上沒有演。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The staging is legible without being reductive: we can follow the action without being handed a final verdict on everyone in it.
options: A. 因無法看懂誰在行動，觀眾只能閱讀節目冊判斷。
B. 說話者認為跟得上劇情就必然喪失人物複雜性。
C. 調度清楚卻不簡化人物；可跟隨行動，未被塞入最終判決。
D. 每人都被明白定為好壞，所以沒有任何可自行理解空間。
normal.explain: 清楚敘事與保留人物複雜可並存。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The reprise does not repeat the emotion so much as reveal how differently the same words can sound after the characters have lost the certainty with which they first spoke them.
options: A. 角色仍同樣確信，所以同句重現只為延長演出。
B. 重現使用全新字句，因此觀眾無法比較兩次語氣。
C. 說話者認為角色失去確信後就完全不能再說原句。
D. 重現較非重複情緒，而是讓同句在角色失去原有確信後顯得不同。
normal.explain: 知識/信念變化使原句重現獲新意。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The production mistakes the intensity of an emotion displayed for the complexity of an emotion understood.
options: A. 作品把情緒展示強度誤當成對情緒複雜性的理解。
B. 作品雖深入理解複雜情緒，卻沒有任何可見表達。
C. 情緒越強烈就已充分證明作品越深入理解人物。
D. 說話者只要求調高音量，而不關心任何情緒詮釋。
normal.explain: 強烈展示不等於細緻理解，非反對所有強情緒。

normal.desc: 【語意】The performance is histrionic where the scene requires reticence. What is criticised?
options: A. Excessive theatrical display displaces a more restrained response.
B. The actor withholds emotion where the scene requires an outburst.
C. The scene has been removed because the actor refuses to perform.
D. A quiet scene is praised for expressing every feeling in full.
normal.explain: histrionic 做作誇張，reticence 克制少言，對比演法不適配。

normal.desc: 【文法】The scene is the more unsettling ___ its threat is never made explicit.
options: A. unless of
B. because
C. although of
D. despite that it
normal.explain: the more ... because ... 表正因不明說而更不安。

normal.desc: 【語用】The critic writes, The lighting knows what the dialogue is too polite to say. What is implied?
options: A. The dialogue gives clear instructions about how each lamp works.
B. The actors speak too quietly for any audience member to hear.
C. Visual choices disclose a tension the spoken words leave implicit.
D. The lighting operator has replaced every line of dialogue.
normal.explain: 擬人化光線比台詞更敢揭露潛在張力，非設備說明。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The ending withholds catharsis rather than merely postponing another revelation. What is withheld?
options: A. A pause between the last two scenes.
B. An emotionally releasing resolution.
C. A final piece of factual information alone.
D. The announcement of the next performance.
normal.explain: catharsis 為情緒宣洩淨化，與資訊揭露不同。

normal.desc: 【修辭】The actor gives the character’s certainty a brittle edge. What does the metaphor suggest?
options: A. The actor has removed any sense that the character believes the words.
B. The scene’s certainty is robust enough to exclude every possible challenge.
C. The assured surface hints at a vulnerability that pressure might expose.
D. The character’s words have become physically impossible to hear.
normal.explain: brittle 易碎，確定表象下脆弱，不等於已全無信念。

normal.desc: 【文法】The silence is made to bear more meaning than the dialogue could comfortably ___.
options: A. sustained
B. sustaining
C. to sustain
D. sustain
normal.explain: could 後原形 sustain；silence bears meaning 為比喻承載。

normal.desc: 【立場】The critic admires virtuosity but resists making difficulty visible for its own sake. What is the preference?
options: A. The audience should be given a full explanation of every difficult gesture.
B. The dramatic effect should be judged solely by the amount of effort displayed.
C. Skill should serve the dramatic effect rather than solicit admiration merely for being hard.
D. A performance should avoid any technique that requires substantial practice.
normal.explain: 肯定技巧但反對為炫難而炫難，不反對高難技巧本身。

normal.desc: 【短文】A production makes each symbolic object conspicuous, then repeats its significance in dialogue and music. A critic says the staging has mistaken resonance for redundancy. What is the concern?
options: A. The objects have become too difficult to see for any interpretation to emerge.
B. The music and dialogue are unrelated because they never return to the objects.
C. Symbolic objects should have no connection with a production’s spoken text.
D. Repeated explanation may narrow the suggestive power it aims to reinforce.
normal.explain: 過度重複解釋可能削弱共鳴開放性，不否定多媒介呼應。

normal.desc: 【語用】The actor’s grief is impeccable; whether it belongs to the character rather than to the idea of great acting is less certain. What distinction is drawn?
options: A. A technically impressive display may not be fully integrated with the role.
B. The critic doubts whether the actor can express grief by any technique.
C. Great acting has been defined as the complete absence of visible emotion.
D. The character’s grief has been proved historically inaccurate by the script.
normal.explain: 演技展示與角色內在適切不同，未否定技巧。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：高超熟練的表演技巧
請唸出單字：戲劇等引起的情緒宣洩與釋放
請唸出：引人注意的視覺構圖
請唸出：情感鋪陳不足而突兀的解決
請唸出：理解不必解決角色困境
normal.ans: RECOGNITION NEED NOT RESOLVE THE PREDICAMENT
normal.speak: recognition need not resolve the predicament
normal.vocabId: R8:RECOGNITION NEED NOT RESOLVE THE PREDICAMENT

normal.desc: 請唸出：可見強度不證成情緒複雜性
normal.ans: VISIBLE INTENSITY DOES NOT ESTABLISH EMOTIONAL COMPLEXITY
normal.speak: visible intensity does not establish emotional complexity
normal.vocabId: R8:VISIBLE INTENSITY DOES NOT ESTABLISH EMOTIONAL COMPLEXITY

normal.desc: 請拼出：情緒或動作過度戲劇化而做作的（H 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：如畫面般安排的舞台場景或定格（T 開頭，7 個字母）
請拼出：把複雜事物過度簡化的（R 開頭，9 個字母）
填空題：R E P _ I S E (先前樂段或表演內容的重現)
填空題：P R E _ I C A _ E N T (難以處理或脫身的困境)
填空題：P _ T _ _ S (使人憐憫或感傷的感染力)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 因未找到地址而退回的郵件
B. 圓融文雅而世故的拒絕
C. 以大聲斥責表達的拒絕
D. 只在城市居民間適用的規則
normal.explain: urbane 描述文雅世故的態度，非城市限制。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 因重要所以必定合理的每項要求
B. 尚未寄出而無人看過的草稿
C. 反覆纏求而造成困擾的請託
D. 一次提出且明說可拒絕的建議
normal.explain: importunate 不等於 important；核心是過度持續索求。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 自然且未經設計的驚訝
B. 因沒讀懂訊息而明白求助
C. 正式承認自己深感焦慮的表態
D. 刻意表現得若無其事的態度
normal.explain: studied 刻意，nonchalance 不在乎般的從容。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The phrase whenever convenient sounds generous until the next line specifies what convenience is expected to look like.
options: A. 對方已說不方便，寄件者因此撤回整封信。
B. 說話者只在懷疑信件行距是否符合印刷規格。
C. 方便時聽來大方，下一行卻規定方便應是什麼樣。
D. 下一行保留任何時間，所以邀請始終毫無限制。
normal.explain: 後句窄化前句表面自由。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The writer’s self-effacement has the paradoxical effect of requiring the recipient to reassure him at every turn.
options: A. 作者完全不需安慰，因自我退讓已消除所有不安。
B. 收件者已停止回覆，所以沒有任何互動期待。
C. 說話者在討論信中文字被擦掉而看不見的問題。
D. 作者自我退讓反讓收件者不斷需要安慰他。
normal.explain: self-effacement 謙退可引出安撫工作，不是物理刪字。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The message is candid about the inconvenience to the sender and remarkably incurious about the inconvenience transferred to the recipient.
options: A. 訊息坦白寄件者的不便，卻不太問轉給收件者的不便。
B. 訊息平均考慮雙方不便，只是文字長度不同。
C. 寄件者已承認收件者更不便，因此撤回要求。
D. 收件者明說不在意不便，所以無需再問。
normal.explain: 自我誠實不保證全面體察他人。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The apology is not insincere so much as exquisitely selective about which part of the offence is allowed to require an apology.
options: A. 道歉完全虛構過錯，因此不存在任何真誠部分。
B. 作者已為所有行為同等承責，沒有任何取捨。
C. 說話者只在稱讚道歉句子的書法漂亮。
D. 道歉較非不真誠，而是精細挑選只有哪部分過錯需要道歉。
normal.explain: 重點是承責範圍選擇，非單一真誠/虛假判定。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The letter’s apparent indifference to the answer becomes harder to credit with each additional assurance that either answer will be perfectly acceptable.
options: A. 越反覆保證任何答案都能接受，表面不在意反而越難相信。
B. 每次保證都已獨立證實作者內心完全不在意。
C. 作者只保證一次，之後便明說只准某種答案。
D. 說話者認為重複語句必定由郵件系統故障造成。
normal.explain: 反覆保證可反向暴露在意，非證明確定內心。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The correspondence turns courtesy into a negotiation over who may state a preference directly and who must translate theirs into concern for someone else.
options: A. 所有偏好都已撤回，因此往來只剩日期的客觀核對。
B. 往來把禮貌變成協商：誰可直說偏好，誰須包裝為替他人著想。
C. 雙方已享有完全相同的直言空間，所以沒有任何權力差異。
D. 說話者只在比較信件是否用外語而需要逐字翻譯。
normal.explain: translate 比喻語用包裝，關注表態負擔分配。

normal.desc: 【語意】The letter’s warmth is punctuated by meticulously impersonal formulations. What pattern is described?
options: A. Punctuation errors prevent the reader identifying any intended tone.
B. Affectionate language is interrupted by carefully detached phrasing.
C. The writer’s detached manner gradually disappears without returning.
D. Every sentence expresses the same degree of personal affection.
normal.explain: punctuated by 比喻不時插入，impersonal 不帶個人情感。

normal.desc: 【文法】The request is phrased as though refusal ___ already been ruled out.
options: A. would to
B. were have
C. had
D. has being
normal.explain: as though + had been 表與當下實情未必相符的先行排除。

normal.desc: 【語用】I should hate to influence your decision, writes a relative, before explaining at length how disappointed everyone will be if it goes the wrong way. What is exposed?
options: A. The relative has consistently refrained from expressing any preferred outcome.
B. The decision has already been announced and cannot be influenced.
C. The writer is simply reporting that every possible outcome is equally welcome.
D. The disclaimer is at odds with the pressure exerted by the message.
normal.explain: 聲稱不影響與預告失望施壓矛盾，不必已剝奪形式選擇。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The writer disclaims authority to decide, not interest in the outcome. What remains compatible?
options: A. The writer has withdrawn every opinion about the outcome.
B. The writer says the decision has no consequences for anyone.
C. The writer may care strongly while denying the right to determine the choice.
D. The writer claims the right to decide because the outcome matters greatly.
normal.explain: authority 與interest 不同；否認決策權不等於不在乎。

normal.desc: 【語意】The refusal is urbane enough to leave the recipient uncertain whether a refusal has occurred. What is suggested?
options: A. The writer has used unfamiliar place names instead of an answer.
B. The refusal is so blunt that its meaning cannot be missed.
C. The recipient already knows the answer but disputes its spelling.
D. Polished courtesy obscures the practical answer.
normal.explain: urbane 文雅世故；過度圓融可能遮住拒絕。

normal.desc: 【文法】The phrase is one to ___ the recipient can assent without agreeing to the proposed action.
options: A. which
B. whom
C. whose
D. that
normal.explain: assent to something，介系詞後關係詞 which。

normal.desc: 【立場】The essay values tact but objects to its use as a means of leaving the less powerful correspondent to infer every inconvenient fact. What is criticised?
options: A. The use of indirect language whenever correspondents know each other well.
B. The claim that an inconvenient fact can be communicated politely.
C. The recipient’s preference for a short answer rather than a long explanation.
D. The unequal allocation of interpretive labour under the guise of courtesy.
normal.explain: 批評把理解壞消息的工作轉嫁弱勢，非所有婉轉都錯。

normal.desc: 【短文】A letter repeatedly says no pressure, then invokes past favours each time the recipient hesitates. The favours are genuine. Why does their truth not settle the letter’s fairness?
options: A. Accurate reminders can still be used to make refusal socially costly.
B. Genuine favours cease to count as favours whenever they are mentioned.
C. A truthful statement guarantees that the resulting request is fair.
D. The recipient’s hesitation proves that the past favours never occurred.
normal.explain: 事實真假與作為施壓手段的適切性不同。

normal.desc: 【語用】The writer offers a choice of dates, every one of which falls within a period the recipient has said is impossible. What is missing from the apparent flexibility?
options: A. An explanation of why dates are normally listed in order.
B. An option responsive to the recipient’s stated constraint.
C. A sufficient number of dates to make a printed calendar.
D. A guarantee that every date will suit every other invitee.
normal.explain: 形式多選但皆不符合已知限制，實用彈性不足。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：看似不在意而從容的態度
請唸出單字：持續纏求而令人困擾的
請唸出：以圓融方式表明無權決定
請唸出：範圍被極仔細限縮的道歉
請唸出：真實提醒仍可能使拒絕有社會代價
normal.ans: A TRUTHFUL REMINDER MAY STILL MAKE REFUSAL SOCIALLY COSTLY
normal.speak: a truthful reminder may still make refusal socially costly
normal.vocabId: R8:A TRUTHFUL REMINDER MAY STILL MAKE REFUSAL SOCIALLY COSTLY

normal.desc: 請唸出：溫情措辭可能遮住受限承諾
normal.ans: AFFECTIONATE WORDING CAN OBSCURE A CAREFULLY LIMITED COMMITMENT
normal.speak: affectionate wording can obscure a carefully limited commitment
normal.vocabId: R8:AFFECTIONATE WORDING CAN OBSCURE A CAREFULLY LIMITED COMMITMENT

normal.desc: 請拼出：文雅圓融而熟悉社交的（U 開頭，6 個字母）
請拼出：反覆纏求而使人困擾的行為（I 開頭，11 個字母）
請拼出：旨在安撫對方減輕不滿的（P 開頭，9 個字母）
填空題：E P I S T _ L A R Y (與書信形式或書信往來有關的)
填空題：D I _ A _ O W (明確否認與某事有關或支持它)
填空題：M _ L _ I _ Y (安撫而減輕某人的怒氣或不滿)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 完全無法延伸的單一點
B. 只有顏色而沒有形狀的表面
C. 彎轉流動而蜿蜒的線條
D. 所有轉角皆成直角的格線
normal.explain: sinuous指流暢曲折，非鋸齒或直角為主。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 對所有問題的永久解決
B. 從未出現任何困難的開始
C. 只因忘記時間而造成的延誤
D. 暫時減輕或延緩不利狀態
normal.explain: reprieve可比喻暫緩困苦，momentary加短暫。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 視野中未見人的遼闊空間
B. 已證實從未有人經過的土地
C. 擠滿人且無法通行的空地
D. 只容一人站立的狹窄平台
normal.explain: unpeopled此處未見人，不保證歷史上無人。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The water seems metallic until a passing cloud returns it to something softer and less certain.
options: A. 水已變成實際金屬，雲使它再次化學轉回水。
B. 雲過後水面反而被描述為更硬更清楚。
C. 說話者認為只有金屬才可能反射任何光線。
D. 水原似金屬，雲過後變得柔和且輪廓較不確定。
normal.explain: 光照轉變以材質比喻呈現，不敘科學相變。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The grandeur is there, but the writing keeps interrupting it with details too awkward to fit comfortably into a postcard.
options: A. 壯麗仍在，文字卻不斷加入不易融入明信片美景的細節。
B. 文字已抹掉所有壯麗，只列難看細節而沒有景物。
C. 作者因明信片空間不夠，所以只討論郵資。
D. 所有細節都理想化，沒有任何使美景複雜的成分。
normal.explain: 不舒適細節打斷純美景框架，非全盤否定壯麗。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The silence gathers around the sound rather than being destroyed by it; the lone bell makes the distance audible.
options: A. 說話者認為只要有鐘，就不可能有任何安靜。
B. 寂靜圍著孤聲而非被破壞，一聲鐘讓距離可感。
C. 鐘聲完全填滿所有空間，所以再無寂靜或距離感。
D. 作者已用鐘聲精確計算所有建築間距。
normal.explain: 孤聲反襯空寂和遠近，audible distance為感受比喻。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The description moves from immensity to minuteness without suggesting that the smaller scale matters less.
options: A. 描寫由浩大轉微細，卻未暗示小尺度較不重要。
B. 描寫只因小物不重要而刪掉所有近景。
C. 尺度從微細轉浩大，作者明說大者一定較有價值。
D. 說話者認為大小可直接用來衡量敘述正確性。
normal.explain: 尺度轉換不等價值排序，方向為immensity到minuteness。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The landscape offers a prospect rather than a promise: its openness does not tell the traveller what will become possible within it.
options: A. 說話者用地景證明未來只可能有單一結果。
B. 地景提供開闊景象而非承諾，開放不預告旅人能做到什麼。
C. 地景因寬闊已保證旅人所有計畫都會成功。
D. 作者拒絕看任何遠景，只願討論已知路線。
normal.explain: prospect與promise文字遊戲，空間開放不保證人生可能。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The last light does not redeem the neglect; it allows us to see, with unusual tenderness, what remains neglected.
options: A. 作者因溫柔觀看而認定失修已不需再處理。
B. 光線沒有讓任何東西可見，因此描述無從成立。
C. 最後光線未救贖失修，而讓人溫柔看清仍被忽略之物。
D. 光一照便實際修復所有損壞，所以失修已消失。
normal.explain: 感受改變與實際狀態未改並存，redeem為比喻。

normal.desc: 【語意】The landscape is desolate without being devoid of presence. What distinction is made?
options: A. Every visible object is identified as belonging to a present owner.
B. The narrator denies that any form of emptiness can be perceived.
C. Its emptiness can feel inhabited by traces or atmosphere.
D. Its crowding prevents any sense of openness or distance.
normal.explain: desolate荒寂與presence存在感可共存，非人數客觀斷定。

normal.desc: 【文法】The light seemed less to illuminate the walls than ___ their accumulated shadows.
options: A. disclosing of
B. had disclosed
C. was disclosing
D. to disclose
normal.explain: seemed less to X than to Y 平行不定詞結構。

normal.desc: 【修辭】The sea kept its own counsel beneath the cliffs. What is conveyed?
options: A. It seems withholding and unreadable rather than communicative.
B. The narrator can hear a spoken legal judgement from the water.
C. The sea has visibly agreed with the travellers’ decision.
D. The cliffs prevent the narrator knowing that a sea is present.
normal.explain: keep own counsel不吐露想法的擬人，非真法律活動。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The account is unsentimental about loneliness without denying its ache. What remains?
options: A. Loneliness is praised as the necessary source of all beauty.
B. The narrator denies having felt any response to being alone.
C. Every lonely moment is recast as evidence of personal strength.
D. Emotional pain is acknowledged without being romanticised.
normal.explain: 不感傷美化仍承認痛感，非冷漠否認。

normal.desc: 【氣氛】The road ran on with the indifference of a sentence that had forgotten its reader. What effect does the simile create?
options: A. The journey feels unresponsive to the traveller’s need for an ending.
B. The road is explained as a written instruction with a missing word.
C. The traveller has forgotten how to read the directions on a sign.
D. The narrator suggests the road ends exactly where the traveller wishes.
normal.explain: road/sentence比喻無止境而不顧閱讀者需求，非識字測驗。

normal.desc: 【文法】The stillness was such ___ the smallest movement seemed intrusive.
options: A. as if of
B. that
C. than
D. what
normal.explain: such that 引程度結果：寂靜使小動作顯突兀。

normal.desc: 【語意】The light lends the abandoned room a momentary reprieve from neglect. What does reprieve suggest?
options: A. A temporary suspension of how neglected the room appears.
B. A permanent restoration of every damaged object in the room.
C. A formal decision to demolish the room at a later date.
D. A memory that the room was never abandoned.
normal.explain: reprieve暫緩，光暫使失修感退後，非實際整修完成。

normal.desc: 【短文】The traveller writes of a landscape beyond time, then records a bus braking behind the hill. The sound is not removed from the final account. What does retaining it allow?
options: A. The retained sound establishes that the landscape’s appearance is entirely artificial.
B. The imagined timelessness remains in tension with the present rather than replacing it.
C. The bus proves that the traveller could not see any part of the landscape.
D. The account resolves the tension by claiming modern transport existed in every period.
normal.explain: 保留現代聲音讓永恆感與當下並存，非抹掉其一。

normal.desc: 【修辭】Nothing moved, except the shadows, which seemed to be deciding where the afternoon should end. What is personified?
options: A. The narrator claims every object has stopped casting a shadow.
B. The changing shadows establish an exact measured time for sunset.
C. The shadows’ gradual movement is given the agency of choosing.
D. The afternoon is shown physically moving the trees to new positions.
normal.explain: 影子擬人決定邊界，非日落時間測量保證。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：隨觀看或照光角度變化的虹彩
請唸出單字：荒寂空落而令人孤絕的狀態
請唸出：蜿蜒延展的一連串影子
請唸出：未被化解的失修忽略感
請唸出：開闊景象未必承諾不同未來
normal.ans: AN OPEN PROSPECT NEED NOT PROMISE A DIFFERENT FUTURE
normal.speak: an open prospect need not promise a different future
normal.vocabId: R8:AN OPEN PROSPECT NEED NOT PROMISE A DIFFERENT FUTURE

normal.desc: 請唸出：最小細節可能打斷宏大敘事
normal.ans: THE SMALLEST DETAIL MAY INTERRUPT A GRAND NARRATIVE
normal.speak: the smallest detail may interrupt a grand narrative
normal.vocabId: R8:THE SMALLEST DETAIL MAY INTERRUPT A GRAND NARRATIVE

normal.desc: 請拼出：形狀流暢蜿蜒而多曲折的（S 開頭，7 個字母）
請拼出：尺度極為浩大遼闊的性質（I 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：聲音反射後持續迴響的現象（R 開頭，13 個字母）
填空題：L U M I N _ S I T Y (明亮或散發光感的性質)
填空題：T E N _ C I _ U S (牢固持續而不易消退的)
填空題：M I _ U T _ N _ S S (極微小或細緻的性質)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 必須依獨一歷史才能決定用途的物件
B. 因長出真菌而不能使用的每種物品
C. 只准由原製作者親手搬動的單位
D. 在指定用途下可由同級另一單位替代的物件
normal.explain: fungible可互代，非fungus真菌；此處已限定用途。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 欠缺必要性的裝飾性添加
B. 被證實每種用途都必需的配件
C. 只因免費就必然有用的物品
D. 未加工且保留原貌的基本材料
normal.explain: gratuitous不必要，embellishment裝飾或潤飾。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 只在紙上畫出的貨幣符號
B. 看似省費卻不成立的節省
C. 已核算且持續成立的成本改善
D. 由政府公布的完整經濟報告
normal.explain: spurious虛假/站不住腳；economy在此節省。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The pleasure of the bargain seems to survive rather better than any recollection of why the object was wanted.
options: A. 撿便宜的快感似乎比原先為何想要物件的記憶更持久。
B. 購物者始終清楚用途，但早已忘記價格是否便宜。
C. 物件被想要只因它從未打折，與便宜無關。
D. 說話者確認物件到家前已被退回。
normal.explain: 價差喜悅蓋過用途記憶的反諷，非實際退貨事件。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The promise of simplicity is complicated by the collection of accessories required to make the simple version perform its advertised function.
options: A. 說話者認為所有簡單設計都不可能包含多個部件。
B. 簡便承諾被所需配件弄複雜，因簡版要靠它們才達宣傳功能。
C. 簡版完全不需配件，所以複雜只存在於包裝圖案。
D. 配件已被證實與任何功能無關，只是可選裝飾。
normal.explain: 整體使用系統複雜度不只看主件名稱。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: It is a generous exchange only if we overlook how conveniently the definition of value excludes the things the recipient must now do.
options: A. 雙方已共同核算每項負擔，因此沒有需要再問之處。
B. 說話者只在比較兩件物的包裝顏色。
C. 交換被稱慷慨，是因價值定義方便地略掉收受者新增工作。
D. 收受者已無任何後續工作，所以價值定義完整。
normal.explain: 把後續負擔排除可美化交換，不預先斷所有交換無益。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The object’s durability is praised as a virtue, while the absence of support for keeping it usable is treated as an unrelated inconvenience.
options: A. 物件一旦耐用，就不可能再需要任何後續服務。
B. 物件耐用受讚，但維持可用的支援缺乏卻被當不相干小事。
C. 支援充足被說成唯一優點，耐用性則完全未被提起。
D. 說話者已證明支援與長期可用性沒有任何關聯。
normal.explain: 材料耐久與維護支援同影響長期可用，不宜任意割開。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The catalogue does not invent the difference; it arranges the comparison so that the difference appears to answer a need the comparison itself has just produced.
options: A. 使用者早已提出同一需求，目錄完全沒有引導其形成。
B. 說話者認為任何比較都必然無法描述真實差異。
C. 目錄未捏造差異，而是藉比較讓差異像在回應比較才製造的需求。
D. 差異已被證實不存在，所以目錄只能靠偽造數字宣傳。
normal.explain: 真實差異仍可被框架轉成新不足感，非全指造假。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What is called a complete set may be complete only relative to a purpose that the purchaser has never adopted.
options: A. 組合已被確認對買家所有實際目的都完全充足。
B. 只要買家沒有目的，任何物件都不能稱作組合。
C. 說話者只在檢查盒內數量是否與出貨單相同。
D. 所謂完整組合可能只對買家未採用的目的而言完整。
normal.explain: 完整性相對用途，非只有物品件數。

normal.desc: 【語意】The objects are fungible within this scheme: any unit of the stated grade may replace another without changing what the recipient receives. What is meant?
options: A. Every object has a unique personal history that determines its exchange value.
B. The scheme permits replacement only when the original object is returned first.
C. The objects may be exchanged only if they were manufactured on the same day.
D. Individual identity does not matter for the scheme’s specified exchange.
normal.explain: 題內給fungible可互代定義，限定方案與級別，不泛化所有特徵。

normal.desc: 【文法】The item is no more useful for ___ described as indispensable.
options: A. being
B. to have
C. been
D. it being has
normal.explain: for後動名詞，宣稱不可或缺並不自動增加效用。

normal.desc: 【語用】A seller calls a feature exclusive; the buyer asks whether that means unavailable elsewhere or merely unnecessary elsewhere. What is questioned?
options: A. Whether a feature can be described without naming its manufacturer.
B. Whether uniqueness is being presented as value without establishing usefulness.
C. Whether the item has been made by more than one worker.
D. Whether every other seller has used the word exclusive in an advertisement.
normal.explain: 以幽默追問獨特是否有用，非否定所有專屬功能。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The critic questions the equivalence claimed for the substitute, not the substitute’s quality in every respect. What remains possible?
options: A. The substitute may be well made yet fail to serve a particular role.
B. The substitute has been established as defective in every available test.
C. A substitute’s quality must be identical to the original’s selling price.
D. The critic accepts equivalence because any difference is merely decorative.
normal.explain: 品質與特定用途等價分開，非全面負評。

normal.desc: 【語意】The display turns sufficiency into a prelude to deficiency: once the new version is shown, the adequate old one is made to look lacking. What is criticised?
options: A. The newer version has fewer features and is therefore necessarily less desirable.
B. Comparison creates a sense of inadequacy without showing that the earlier purpose is unmet.
C. The old version has stopped functioning because the new one is physically nearby.
D. The display proves the old version was never adequate for its original purpose.
normal.explain: 展示框架改變感受，非功能已自然失效。

normal.desc: 【文法】The assurance is one on ___ the buyer cannot rely without knowing its limits.
options: A. whose
B. that
C. which
D. whom
normal.explain: rely on，介系詞後關係詞which。

normal.desc: 【立場】The essay resists equating acquisition with enrichment while allowing that a particular object can genuinely enrich a life. What is rejected?
options: A. The distinction between acquiring and borrowing an object.
B. The automatic inference that possessing more means living better.
C. The possibility that any owned object carries personal significance.
D. The act of comparing objects before choosing one.
normal.explain: 拒絕自動量多即好，不否定具體情感/實用價值。

normal.desc: 【短文】The catalogue describes a basic feature as a generous extra after removing it from the standard version. The feature itself has not changed. What shift is central?
options: A. The catalogue has announced that no version will contain the feature again.
B. The product’s physical dimensions have changed to make the feature fit.
C. The baseline has been altered so restoration appears to be a bonus.
D. The feature has become technically impossible to include in a standard version.
normal.explain: 移動標準起點使原功能重獲被宣傳為加碼。

normal.desc: 【語用】The offer promises freedom from choice by supplying a complete collection, provided the buyer accepts the supplier’s definition of completeness. What is the qualification?
options: A. The buyer is invited to define every item independently before the collection is made.
B. The supplier has guaranteed that every person needs precisely the same objects.
C. The offer eliminates any need to receive or store the collection.
D. Convenience depends on adopting someone else’s account of what is needed.
normal.explain: 省選擇的便利仍以接受需求定義為前提。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：在指定用途下可由同等單位互換的
請唸出單字：多於所需而顯得多餘的數量或事物
請唸出：貌似節省而不成立的表象
請唸出：未明說地重新定義足夠
請唸出：恢復的功能可能被包裝成慷慨加碼
normal.ans: A RESTORED FEATURE CAN BE MARKETED AS A GENEROUS EXTRA
normal.speak: a restored feature can be marketed as a generous extra
normal.vocabId: R8:A RESTORED FEATURE CAN BE MARKETED AS A GENEROUS EXTRA

normal.desc: 請唸出：完整性相對於所服務目的
normal.ans: COMPLETENESS IS RELATIVE TO THE PURPOSE BEING SERVED
normal.speak: completeness is relative to the purpose being served
normal.vocabId: R8:COMPLETENESS IS RELATIVE TO THE PURPOSE BEING SERVED

normal.desc: 請拼出：不必要而缺乏適當理由的（G 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：為炫耀而刻意引人注意的（O 開頭，12 個字母）
請拼出：超出所需而多餘的（S 開頭，11 個字母）
填空題：I N C O N _ R U I T Y (事物彼此不協調不相稱之處)
填空題：P R O P _ R T I _ N A T E (與重要性或規模相稱的)
填空題：E X _ E N _ A _ L E (可在需要時放棄而不嚴重影響主要目的的)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 不能由前面所述推得的結論
B. 經明示規則必然推得的後果
C. 故意不依時間排列的每段故事
D. 僅因沒有數字就不成立的句子
normal.explain: nonsequitur拉丁語指推論不相隨，非單指時間不順。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 完全與事件無關而無任何解讀可能的物件
B. 容許不同解讀的不明確線索
C. 只因作者沒命名就必為假線索
D. 已唯一確定行動者的證據
normal.explain: equivocal多義/不明確，不是必假或全無關。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 只用增加敘事篇幅的每個描述
B. 經聲音大小而判斷真偽的方法
C. 有助減輕責任或反駁指控的細節
D. 必定能證明所有人有責的細節
normal.explain: exculpatory有利解責，不保證全案無疑。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Her apparent foreknowledge is puzzling only if the announcement was private, which the story has not told us.
options: A. 說話者只質疑公告字體，與誰能看見無關。
B. 她事先知情是否奇怪，取決公告是否私密，而故事未交代。
C. 故事已明說公告私密，所以事先知情完全無須解釋。
D. 公告已確定公開給她，故她已直接承認讀過。
normal.explain: 未給資訊存取範圍，不能補密傳前提。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The inference is valid given the premise; the difficulty is that the premise has quietly been borrowed from the conclusion it is meant to support.
options: A. 推論在邏輯上無效，因任何前提都不可能支持結論。
B. 說話者只在批評結論寫得比前提長。
C. 若接受前提推論有效，但前提卻暗中借自要支持的結論。
D. 前提由獨立觀察確立，所以結論沒有循環問題。
normal.explain: 假設性有效與前提循環來源可並存。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: An account that accommodates every conceivable reaction may explain less than one that tells us what reaction would count against it.
options: A. 說明只要能把每種結果說通，就必定有最強檢驗力。
B. 能指出反駁條件已保證該說明必定為真。
C. 說話者認為人物反應不可能作任何敘事線索。
D. 能吸收所有反應的說明，可能不如指出何種反應會反駁它的說明。
normal.explain: 辨識力/可反駁界線不同於事後包容一切，may留餘地。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The coincidence is striking; treating its strikingness as a measure of its impossibility is another matter.
options: A. 說話者否認這些事件碰巧同時發生。
B. 巧合已被確定由某人故意安排。
C. 巧合醒目，但醒目程度不是不可能程度的量尺。
D. 巧合愈醒目就已由定義保證愈不可能發生。
normal.explain: 主觀驚訝不直接給機率或不可能證明。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The explanation has become insulated from correction by treating every failure of fit as evidence that the concealment was more ingenious than previously supposed.
options: A. 每次不合都促使解釋修正，所以它已充分接受檢驗。
B. 隱藏手法已由獨立觀察逐項證實，沒有推論跳躍。
C. 說話者認為任何巧妙隱藏都不可能被人發現。
D. 每次不合都說是隱藏更巧妙，使解釋不再接受修正。
normal.explain: 把反例重編成支持可免疫反駁，不等於已證全假。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The narrator knows more than the characters, but the reader is not entitled to transfer that surplus knowledge into a character’s motives without a textual reason.
options: A. 敘述者多知道的資訊，不可無文本依據塞進角色動機。
B. 只要讀者知道，角色便按敘事規則自動知道。
C. 角色未明說動機，就已確定不存在任何動機。
D. 說話者認為敘述者與讀者所知永遠完全相同。
normal.explain: 敘事知識層級不同，避免全知者知識污染角色推論。

normal.desc: 【語意】The clue is exculpatory with respect to one allegation, not exonerating in every respect. What is clarified?
options: A. It weakens a specific claim without settling all questions about the person.
B. It proves the person responsible for every event in the story.
C. It has no bearing on any allegation because it concerns only one detail.
D. It withdraws the allegation by showing that the event never occurred at all.
normal.explain: exculpatory特定解責範圍不等於所有問題全洗清。

normal.desc: 【文法】The remark betrays more knowledge than its speaker could reasonably ___.
options: A. has acquired by chance
B. have acquired by chance
C. had acquiring by chance
D. to acquire by chance
normal.explain: could have acquired 表先前可能取得的知識。

normal.desc: 【語用】The detective says, He has an explanation for everything, which is beginning to look like an explanation for nothing. What is the concern?
options: A. The suspect has refused to offer any explanation for the events.
B. The account has been independently tested and rejected in every detail.
C. The account may be so adaptable that it fails to distinguish possible outcomes.
D. The speaker objects because the account leaves every supplied event unexplained.
normal.explain: 任意結果都能吸收的說明可能缺辨識/檢驗力，非已逐項證假。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The fact is incontrovertible; the significance attributed to it is not. What remains open?
options: A. Whether the interpreter has used any words to describe it.
B. How the undisputed fact should be interpreted.
C. Whether the fact was ever recorded at all.
D. Whether the fact is accepted as having occurred.
normal.explain: 事實無爭不等於解釋無爭，兩層區分。

normal.desc: 【短文】A theory treats surprise as staged innocence and a lack of surprise as guilty foreknowledge. Its author adds these interpretations after seeing each reaction and specifies no response that would challenge the theory. What is problematic?
options: A. The character’s reactions have been recorded before the theory was formulated.
B. The theorist has explicitly left both explanations open pending further evidence.
C. Either reaction is made to confirm a preferred account through post hoc interpretation.
D. The theory has identified a reaction that would count against the preferred account.
normal.explain: 事後對不同反應配方便解釋，缺可反駁界線。

normal.desc: 【文法】The inference depends on a premise, the truth of ___ has not been established.
options: A. whose
B. that
C. what
D. which
normal.explain: the truth of which 為關係子句，which指premise。

normal.desc: 【語意】The explanation’s parsimony is real, but parsimony is not a substitute for fit. What is acknowledged and limited?
options: A. Any account with fewer assumptions is necessarily less accurate.
B. The facts should be discarded when they require a more complex explanation.
C. Economy of assumptions matters but cannot compensate for conflict with the facts.
D. The explanation fits every fact precisely because it uses fewer assumptions.
normal.explain: 簡省有價值但非犧牲符合證據的理由。

normal.desc: 【短文】The story tells us that only one of two identical notes was written before noon, but never identifies which one. A reader assigns the earlier note to a named character without further evidence. What has been exceeded?
options: A. The number of notes the story permits to exist.
B. The stated possibility that anyone could write before noon.
C. The distinction between identical wording and different handwriting.
D. The determinacy supplied by the narrative.
normal.explain: 有唯一早note不等於讀者能辨誰，無資料補名超出確定度。

normal.desc: 【語用】The witness could hardly have failed to notice the red coat is paraphrased as The witness says she noticed the red coat. What changed?
options: A. An inference about likely awareness has become attributed testimony.
B. A direct quotation has become a weaker report of an acknowledged memory lapse.
C. The witness’s description of a blue coat has been corrected to red.
D. An assertion of impossibility has been replaced by a measurement of distance.
normal.explain: couldhardlyhavefailed推論近乎必注意，不等於見證者親口說。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：解釋中不多設不必要假設的簡省
請唸出單字：對事物形成的錯誤理解
請唸出：論證中不由前提推得的結論
normal.ans: A NON SEQUITUR IN THE ARGUMENT
normal.speak: a non sequitur in the argument
normal.vocabId: R8:A NON SEQUITUR IN THE ARGUMENT

normal.desc: 請唸出：循環地宣稱取得獨立確認
normal.ans: A CIRCULAR CLAIM TO INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION
normal.speak: a circular claim to independent confirmation
normal.vocabId: R8:A CIRCULAR CLAIM TO INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION

normal.desc: 請唸出：有效推論仍取決前提地位
normal.ans: A VALID INFERENCE STILL DEPENDS ON THE STATUS OF ITS PREMISE
normal.speak: a valid inference still depends on the status of its premise
normal.vocabId: R8:A VALID INFERENCE STILL DEPENDS ON THE STATUS OF ITS PREMISE

normal.desc: 請唸出：醒目巧合不證成蓄意協調
normal.ans: STRIKING COINCIDENCE DOES NOT ESTABLISH DELIBERATE COORDINATION
normal.speak: striking coincidence does not establish deliberate coordination
normal.vocabId: R8:STRIKING COINCIDENCE DOES NOT ESTABLISH DELIBERATE COORDINATION

normal.desc: 請拼出：由已成立命題隨之推得的結果（C 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：證明某人對被指之事無責而使其洗清（E 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：使某人看來涉及某件不利事件（I 開頭，9 個字母）
填空題：D E D U _ T I V E (由前提依推理推出結論的)
填空題：E X C _ L P _ T E (解除某人對特定過錯的責任)
填空題：D E _ E R _ I N _ C Y (意義或答案可被唯一確定的性質)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 未曾涉及任何爭點的私人筆記
B. 對爭議作權威裁決的決定
C. 只為引起討論而未表立場的提問
D. 隨機抽牌後的每個自動結果
normal.explain: adjudicative關裁決，非純討論。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 因未到輪次而尚不能看的卡片
B. 永遠無法影響任何計分的裝飾
C. 對先前已做行動生效的例外
D. 只對未來新遊戲才適用的規則
normal.explain: retroactive回溯適用，未評其一定公平。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 未另說明時一律禁止的預設
B. 每次必須由旁觀者強迫執行的指令
C. 只能在最後一回合使用的獎勵
D. 未另限制時原則上允許的預設
normal.explain: permissive允許，default原則設定，非義務。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The exception is available to either player, but not to both in the same round.
options: A. 只有先加入遊戲的那人有資格用。
B. 兩人同時用時會自動加倍獎勵。
C. 任一方可用例外，但同輪不能雙方都用。
D. 例外必須同輪雙方一起使用才生效。
normal.explain: either與notboth形成互斥單次資格。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The ruling may be sensible as a rule for next time without being fair as a rule invented after this move.
options: A. 新規則內容合理已保證回溯用到任何過去都公平。
B. 說話者確認新規則無論何時都毫無道理。
C. 規則既能改，下次就不需在開始前告知。
D. 裁決作下次規則可能合理，作本次行動後新規則卻未必公平。
normal.explain: 實質可取與溯及適切性不同，may保留。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The game leaves room for interpretation, which need not mean it leaves the result to whoever argues most loudly.
options: A. 遊戲留解釋空間，不等於結果應由最大聲者決定。
B. 只要有解釋空間，就沒有任何可用判準。
C. 每個解釋都必須相同，否則遊戲立即停止。
D. 說話者主張音量才是正式計分方式。
normal.explain: 裁量空間可有理由標準，非聲勢支配。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: What looks like an exception to the limit may instead be an instruction about when the limit is measured.
options: A. 限制已被正式永久取消，所以不需計量。
B. 例外與計量時點在規則裡已被定義為相同詞。
C. 說話者確認每次計量都一定發生在行動前。
D. 看似限制例外，也可能是在說何時計量限制。
normal.explain: 不同解讀須讀範圍/時點，may非定案。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The rule’s symmetry is formal: each player has the same permission, but only one currently has the resources needed to exercise it.
options: A. 規則形式對稱，兩方同准，但目前只有一方有資源行使。
B. 兩人資源已完全同等，所以許可的實用性也同。
C. 只要資源不同，兩人的文字許可就必定不同。
D. 說話者要求取消資源系統以避免任何選擇。
normal.explain: 形式許可對稱不代表當下行使能力相同，不預定必不公。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: A victory condition that can be redefined whenever it is met risks turning an achievable goal into an indefinitely receding one.
options: A. 說話者認為遊戲只要有目標就不該設任何挑戰。
B. 每達成都重定勝利條件，可能使目標無限後移。
C. 勝利條件從未改動，只因玩家尚未得足分。
D. 目標可達已證明不論如何改條件都公平。
normal.explain: 風險來自移動門檻而非挑戰本身。

normal.desc: 【語意】The ruling is retrospective in its effect: it changes how an earlier move is scored. What is affected?
options: A. The physical order in which the earlier cards were drawn.
B. The assessment of an action already taken.
C. Only the wording used for future instructions.
D. The player’s knowledge before the earlier action occurred.
normal.explain: retrospective效力在先前一步的計分，非改真實過去順序。

normal.desc: 【文法】The rule allows the move, ___ it does not require.
options: A. whose
B. what
C. which
D. that
normal.explain: 非限定關係子句which作require受詞，it指rule。

normal.desc: 【語用】The organiser calls the rule self-evident after spending ten minutes explaining which exceptions count as exceptions. What invites irony?
options: A. The organiser has refused to give any explanation of the rule.
B. Every exception has been deleted from the written rule before play.
C. The length of an explanation establishes that its content is false.
D. The explanation’s burden sits uneasily with the claim of obviousness.
normal.explain: 自明聲稱與大量解例外有張力，非長就假。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The absence of a prohibition makes a move permissible under this game’s stated default, not obligatory. What follows?
options: A. The move remains forbidden until a second rule requires it.
B. The player must change the default before making any choice.
C. The player may choose the move but need not take it.
D. The player must take the move whenever it becomes possible.
normal.explain: 題內給default未禁可做，仍非必做。

normal.desc: 【規則】A later rule expressly supersedes an earlier scoring rule, but only for team matches. An individual match is being played. What remains applicable on the stated facts?
options: A. The later scoring rule for every kind of match.
B. Neither rule, because supersession always removes all previous text.
C. A new score agreed after seeing which player would benefit.
D. The earlier scoring rule for that individual match.
normal.explain: supersedes範圍限團體，不能外推個人賽。

normal.desc: 【語意】The decision is discretionary but not therefore arbitrary. What distinction matters?
options: A. Judgement can have reasons even when a rule leaves room for it.
B. Any decision not mechanically fixed must lack a rational basis.
C. A discretionary decision is one that cannot affect the outcome.
D. An arbitrary decision is always the only option allowed by a rule.
normal.explain: 裁量非必恣意，理由可約束未機械化處。

normal.desc: 【指涉】The objection concerns changing the rule after the move, not the content of the rule as a possible rule for future games. Which response addresses it?
options: A. Show that the revised rule would make future games more interesting.
B. Repeat the new rule more loudly so all players hear it.
C. Explain that the organiser personally prefers the new outcome.
D. Keep the earlier scoring basis for this move and discuss a revision before future play.
normal.explain: 程序溯及爭點需保留行動時基準，非只辯新內容更好。

normal.desc: 【短文】A game rewards cooperation but reveals a private bonus for betrayal only after players have made binding promises. A critic asks whether surprise has displaced meaningful choice. What is questioned?
options: A. Whether players had the information needed to understand the commitments they made.
B. Whether private information can ever be part of a well-designed game.
C. Whether every promise in a game must remain enforceable outside it.
D. Whether betrayal should always score fewer points than cooperation.
normal.explain: 批評知情時點與承諾而非一概禁隱資訊。

normal.desc: 【語用】The organiser says the decision is final, then offers that finality as evidence that the decision must be correct. What is conflated?
options: A. A player’s right to ask a question with a duty to agree.
B. Authority to end a dispute with the merits of its resolution.
C. A temporary ruling with the absence of any ruling.
D. The number of players with the number of disputed moves.
normal.explain: 終局權限不等於判斷實質正確性。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：對爭議作權威判定的程序
請唸出單字：依條件而失去權利或資源的結果
請唸出：事後回溯加上的條件
請唸出：形式上對稱的許可
請唸出：裁決終局性不證成其正確
normal.ans: FINALITY OF A RULING DOES NOT ESTABLISH ITS CORRECTNESS
normal.speak: finality of a ruling does not establish its correctness
normal.vocabId: R8:FINALITY OF A RULING DOES NOT ESTABLISH ITS CORRECTNESS

normal.desc: 請唸出：可達目標不應每達成就後退
normal.ans: AN ACHIEVABLE GOAL SHOULD NOT RECEDE WHENEVER IT IS REACHED
normal.speak: an achievable goal should not recede whenever it is reached
normal.vocabId: R8:AN ACHIEVABLE GOAL SHOULD NOT RECEDE WHENEVER IT IS REACHED

normal.desc: 請拼出：對爭議作具權威的裁定（A 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：取代先前規則或安排而優先適用（S 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：對先前行動或事件回溯生效的性質（R 開頭，13 個字母）
填空題：P E R M I S S _ B I L I T Y (依規則被允許的性質)
填空題：P R O _ I B I _ I O N (明確禁止某行為的規定)
填空題：R E V _ R S _ B I _ I T Y (能恢復先前狀態的性質)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 經獨立查核所有細節的完整紀錄
B. 刻意只寫過失而不提優點的文章
C. 把人物近乎聖人化而少談缺點的描寫
D. 只介紹人物日常作息而無任何評價
normal.explain: hagiographic可比喻過度歌頌傳記。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 完全不經任何表達就直接取得的過去
B. 只因錄音音量低就必為假的回答
C. 已證與說話者毫無任何關係的故事
D. 經敘述情境或呈現方式中介的回憶
normal.explain: mediated指受呈現/互動過程中介，非自動造假。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 未美化對象且可能顯其缺點的回憶
B. 只為討好聽者而全面歌頌的故事
C. 因沒留照片而不准談起的經歷
D. 不含任何人物或情感的時間表
normal.explain: unflattering不替人美化，非必惡意失真。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The hesitation is audible; the motive assigned to it belongs to the editor rather than to anything the speaker explicitly says.
options: A. 本人已明說遲疑動機，所以編輯只是逐字保留。
B. 編輯已刪掉遲疑，因此錄音完全不含停頓。
C. 說話者確認所有遲疑都出於同一種動機。
D. 遲疑可聽見，所賦動機卻是編輯加的而非本人明說。
normal.explain: 觀察線索與解釋歸屬不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The narrative’s coherence may tell us as much about the needs of the present telling as about the orderliness of the life being told.
options: A. 敘事連貫也可能反映現在講述需求，不只過去人生有多整齊。
B. 人生當年必定完全連貫，因現在故事講得順。
C. 現在講述需求已證過去事件從未發生。
D. 說話者只在比較故事長短，沒有討論組織方式。
normal.explain: 現在建構意義與過去經歷組織不可直接等同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: An editorial act can be protective and still deprive the reader of information needed to understand the speaker’s own qualification.
options: A. 說話者認為任何保護受訪者的考量都必須放棄。
B. 編輯可出於保護，仍可能刪去理解本人限定所需資訊。
C. 只要意在保護，就不可能影響讀者理解任何限定。
D. 編輯已完整留下所有限定，所以沒有資訊取捨。
normal.explain: 善意與資訊效果可不一致，不否定保護本身。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: To keep the contradiction is not to accuse the speaker; it is to resist making memory answer to a tidiness the interview itself did not possess.
options: A. 保留矛盾不是指控說話者，而是拒絕替原訪談強加整齊。
B. 保留矛盾已等於判定說話者必定蓄意欺騙。
C. 原訪談毫無矛盾，所以編輯需另造矛盾增趣。
D. 說話者主張紀錄不需提供任何可理解脈絡。
normal.explain: 保存複雜性不同於定罪/人格缺陷判斷。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The account’s verisimilitude is an effect worth studying, not a substitute for asking which of its claims can be checked and how.
options: A. 說話者認為只有毫無細節的故事才可能真。
B. 逼真感值得研究，但不能代替查問主張如何驗證。
C. 逼真感已逐項確認全部內容，所以不需其他紀錄。
D. 只要查驗主張，就必須否認敘述有任何文學效果。
normal.explain: 效果與核實標準不同，不否定敘事價值。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The question does not simply recover a memory waiting intact; it offers a frame within which a memory becomes tellable to this listener now.
options: A. 記憶受框架影響已證說話者並未經歷任何事。
B. 說話者認為只有沒有聽者時才可談過去。
C. 提問非只取出完整記憶，也提供此刻向這位聽者敘述的框架。
D. 每份記憶都像完整影片，任何提問只會原樣播放。
normal.explain: 互動影響敘事呈現，非否認過去或所有記憶。

normal.desc: 【語意】The portrait is hagiographic rather than merely affectionate. What extra tendency is implied?
options: A. It refuses to describe any admirable quality in the subject.
B. It is concerned only with the subject’s choice of profession.
C. Its admiration suppresses faults and approaches idealisation.
D. Its affection is expressed in unusually brief sentences.
normal.explain: hagiographic比單純喜愛更像聖人傳式美化。

normal.desc: 【文法】The account is no less mediated for ___ told in the speaker’s own voice.
options: A. to be
B. been
C. it has
D. being
normal.explain: for後動名詞being；ownvoice不代表無中介。

normal.desc: 【語用】The interviewer says, Let us return to what you really felt, after the speaker has given an answer he finds disappointing. What should be questioned?
options: A. The assumption that an unwelcome answer is not the speaker’s genuine feeling.
B. The possibility that an interviewer may ever ask for clarification.
C. The speaker’s ability to hear the question in the recording.
D. The claim that the interview took place after the event described.
normal.explain: really felt可能偷換為訪談者想聽答案，非禁所有追問。

normal.desc: 【範圍】The critic questions the representativeness of the memory, not its sincerity. What remains possible?
options: A. The speaker has knowingly invented the whole episode.
B. A sincere account must represent every similar life.
C. The critic accepts the episode as a complete statistical survey.
D. An honestly recalled episode may still be atypical.
normal.explain: 真誠與代表性不同，不因誠實就普遍。

normal.desc: 【修辭】The interview polishes uncertainty into a reassuringly continuous life. What transformation is criticised?
options: A. Editing makes a hesitant recollection appear more coherent than its telling warrants.
B. The recording’s sound is cleaned without altering the sequence or wording.
C. The interviewee has explicitly chosen to withdraw every uncertain statement.
D. The life described has become physically longer because more words are used.
normal.explain: polishes比喻敘事理順，非單純除音噪。

normal.desc: 【文法】The silence is an answer, though not necessarily the one the interviewer would prefer ___ it.
options: A. to have find
B. to find in
C. finding to
D. had found of
normal.explain: would prefer to find in it，it指silence。

normal.desc: 【立場】The essay rejects the assumption that an unguarded voice is an unmediated past. What distinction is central?
options: A. Spontaneous-seeming speech still involves present narration of earlier experience.
B. Only written narratives can be shaped by their intended audience.
C. A recording with no script necessarily gives complete access to past events.
D. The past cannot be discussed unless every sentence is formally prepared.
normal.explain: 自然口語仍為現在講述，不是過去直接未中介顯現。

normal.desc: 【短文】The interviewer edits out his questions to let the speaker appear to speak entirely for herself. Those questions determined the sequence and topics. What does the edit conceal?
options: A. The physical appearance of the room in which the interview occurred.
B. The interaction that helped produce the supposedly autonomous account.
C. The speaker’s right to use words the interviewer did not supply.
D. The fact that every answer was prepared before the interview began.
normal.explain: 刪問句可隱藏共同生成框架，非證每句由訪談者寫。

normal.desc: 【語用】A listener praises the account as too artless to be anything but true. What inference needs scrutiny?
options: A. The listener has distinguished sincerity from factual completeness.
B. The speaker has formally refused to be quoted.
C. An impression of spontaneity is being treated as a guarantee of accuracy.
D. A verified date is being used to identify the location of a remembered event.
normal.explain: artless自然不矯飾感≠真實性保證。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：人物內在思想感受的領域
請唸出單字：看似自然坦率而不矯飾的性質
請唸出：把一生聖人化美化的重構
normal.ans: A HAGIOGRAPHIC RECONSTRUCTION OF A LIFE
normal.speak: a hagiographic reconstruction of a life
normal.vocabId: R8:A HAGIOGRAPHIC RECONSTRUCTION OF A LIFE

normal.desc: 請唸出：無法忽略雙方互動生成的敘述
請唸出：熟悉聲音可被排成另一人的論點
normal.ans: A FAMILIAR VOICE CAN BE ARRANGED INTO SOMEONE ELSE'S ARGUMENT
normal.speak: a familiar voice can be arranged into someone else's argument
normal.vocabId: R8:A FAMILIAR VOICE CAN BE ARRANGED INTO SOMEONE ELSE'S ARGUMENT

normal.desc: 請唸出：自然不矯飾不保證事實準確
normal.ans: ARTLESSNESS DOES NOT GUARANTEE FACTUAL ACCURACY
normal.speak: artlessness does not guarantee factual accuracy
normal.vocabId: R8:ARTLESSNESS DOES NOT GUARANTEE FACTUAL ACCURACY

normal.desc: 請拼出：原指聖人傳，此處比喻忽略缺點的過度讚頌傳記（H 開頭，11 個字母）
請拼出：敘事或表現逼真可信的效果（V 開頭，14 個字母）
