填空題：A U T O B I O G _ A P H I C A L (關於本人生活經歷的自傳性的)
填空題：F A L _ I B I _ I T Y (可能犯錯而非絕對可靠的性質)
填空題：S E _ E C _ I V _ T Y (只選取部分資訊而非全部的性質)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I would be hard pressed to call that a resounding success.
options: A. 我毫不猶豫地認定那是空前成功。
B. 我必須用力按下成功按鈕。
C. 我確認那是徹底失敗，毫無任何成果。
D. 我很難把那稱為大獲成功。
boss.explain: hard pressed to 表示很難；對大獲成功有保留，不等於宣告全盤失敗。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The argument trades on an ambiguity that disappears as soon as the terms are defined.
options: A. 論點利用了歧義，而用語一旦定義清楚，歧義就消失。
B. 論點因精確定義而獲得更強證據。
C. 用語定義會讓歧義永遠無法解決。
D. 論點只涉及商品買賣，與語言無關。
boss.explain: trade on 是利用某事獲利或取得優勢；此處被利用的是未定義用語造成的歧義。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: To say the outcome was foreseeable is not to say that any particular participant foresaw it, still less that they intended it.
options: A. 結果不可預見，因此沒有人需要解釋。
B. 結果可預見，不代表特定參與者真的預見，更不代表刻意造成。
C. 結果可預見就證明所有人刻意促成。
D. 所有參與者都已承認預見並計畫結果。
boss.explain: 依序區分可預見性、實際預見與意圖；still less 進一步排除更強推論。

boss.desc: 【文法】Such ___ the complexity of the negotiations that even the participants struggled to explain the outcome.
options: A. were
B. have been
C. being
D. was
boss.explain: 此倒裝結構為 Such was＋單數名詞片語＋that...；主詞 complexity 為單數。

boss.desc: 【語意】The report is exhaustive without being exhausting. What contrast is intended?
options: A. It is comprehensive yet does not tire the reader.
B. It is incomplete yet difficult to finish.
C. It is deliberately repetitive and confusing.
D. It is brief because it omits every important detail.
boss.explain: exhaustive 是詳盡，exhausting 是令人疲累；兩者同源但意思不同。

boss.desc: 【細微立場】The critic writes: The proposal is not so much wrong as insufficiently alive to the problem it purports to solve. What is the main objection?
options: A. The critic accepts its understanding of the problem without reservation.
B. It inadequately recognises the problem’s complexity despite claiming to address it.
C. Every factual statement in it is demonstrably false.
D. It offers no claim to address any problem.
boss.explain: not so much A as B 把批評焦點轉向 B；alive to 指充分意識到，purports to 保留對宣稱的距離。

boss.desc: 請唸出：以微弱稱讚暗示貶抑
boss.speak: damning with faint praise

boss.desc: 請唸出：可預見性本身不能證明意圖
boss.ans: FORESEEABILITY DOES NOT IN ITSELF ESTABLISH INTENT
boss.speak: foreseeability does not in itself establish intent
boss.vocabId: R8:FORESEEABILITY DOES NOT IN ITSELF ESTABLISH INTENT

boss.desc: 填空題：C I R C U M S _ E C T I O N (採取行動前審慎考慮各種情況)
boss.speak: circumspection

boss.desc: 填空題：S P _ C _ O _ S (表面看似合理但實際有誤的)
boss.speak: specious

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The hospitality was impeccable, if a little studied.
options: A. 招待無可挑剔，但略顯刻意安排。
B. 招待很自然，卻有明顯服務失誤。
C. 招待尚未開始，正在研究中。
D. 招待因沒有事前準備而完全失敗。
boss.explain: studied 此處是刻意、經過精心安排，不是正在讀書；if 補充保留。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Their refusal to take sides is being read as a position in its own right.
options: A. 他們拒絕讓任何人閱讀聲明。
B. 他們拒絕選邊本身正被解讀為一種立場。
C. 他們已明白宣布支持其中一方。
D. 外界完全不對他們的中立作任何解讀。
boss.explain: in its own right 指本身即構成；being read as 是被詮釋為。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The invitation to be heard carries little weight if the terms of recognition have already been settled by those doing the listening.
options: A. 傾聽者尚未決定任何程序，所以不能邀請人發言。
B. 只有被邀請者才能決定全部認可標準。
C. 若傾聽者早已決定哪些聲音才算數，邀請發言的意義就有限。
D. 只要安排發言時間，就必然保證平等影響力。
boss.explain: 條件句質疑預設認可框架對發言意義的限制；不把發言機會等同實質平等。

boss.desc: 【文法】___ that the deadline had already passed, the organisers would have revised the invitation.
options: A. Had it been made clear
B. Had made it clear
C. Were it make clear
D. Has it been making clear
boss.explain: 過去反事實被動倒裝為 Had it been made clear，相當於 If it had been made clear。

boss.desc: 【論證】The curator’s claim to speak for the community sits uneasily with the absence of community involvement. What is being questioned?
options: A. The physical location of the exhibition space.
B. The legitimacy of the claimed representative role.
C. The fact that any community exists in the area.
D. The curator’s ability to speak the local language.
boss.explain: sits uneasily with 表示代表性主張與欠缺參與之間存在矛盾，焦點是正當性。

boss.desc: 【語意】The proposal’s defenders invoke tradition less as a source of guidance than as a means of foreclosing discussion. What is the criticism?
options: A. The defenders are offering historical evidence open to unrestricted debate.
B. The proposal has been criticised solely because it is new.
C. Tradition is being used to prevent scrutiny rather than to inform deliberation.
D. Tradition has ceased to play any part in the defence of the proposal.
boss.explain: less A than B 說明傳統被用來關閉討論，而非提供可檢驗的指引。

boss.desc: 請唸出：只做表面修飾的做法
boss.speak: an exercise in window dressing

boss.desc: 請唸出：她得體地接受了卻仍隱藏保留
boss.ans: HER GRACIOUS ACCEPTANCE CONCEALED A LINGERING RESERVATION
boss.speak: her gracious acceptance concealed a lingering reservation
boss.vocabId: R8:HER GRACIOUS ACCEPTANCE CONCEALED A LINGERING RESERVATION

boss.desc: 填空題：P A T E R _ A L I S M (自認為他人好而限制其自主的做法)
boss.speak: paternalism

boss.desc: 填空題：D I _ S _ M _ L E (隱藏真實感受或意圖而故作姿態)
boss.speak: dissemble

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The assurance is carefully worded to imply more than it actually commits the company to.
options: A. 公司公開撤回了原先的全部承諾。
B. 保證刻意讓人聯想到比公司實際承諾更多的內容。
C. 公司已明確承諾所有可能聯想到的事項。
D. 措辭完全沒有暗示，只列出可執行條款。
boss.explain: imply 與 commit to 的落差是重點；暗示不是可直接等同的承諾。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The phrase does rhetorical work that the supporting evidence has yet to earn.
options: A. 說話者只在討論修辭工作的薪資。
B. 這個說法因文法錯誤而無法理解。
C. 這個說法營造的說服效果超過目前證據足以支持的程度。
D. 證據已充分支持措辭中的每個暗示。
boss.explain: has yet to earn 暗示證據尚未取得相應支持力；重點是修辭超前。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The difficulty is not that the distinction cannot be drawn, but that drawing it this way quietly settles the very dispute it purports merely to describe.
options: A. 這個區分在任何情況下都完全無法表達。
B. 劃界方式已由雙方公開同意且毫無爭議。
C. 說話者只是要求把描述寫得更短。
D. 問題不是無法區分，而是這樣劃界已暗中替它聲稱只是描述的爭議下了判斷。
boss.explain: 區分描述性姿態與劃界所帶入的實質判斷；不是否認所有區分都可能。

boss.desc: 【文法】___ the information be found to have been misleading, the assurance would lose much of its force.
options: A. Did
B. Should
C. Had
D. Were
boss.explain: Should＋主詞＋原形動詞 be 構成正式假設條件倒裝；Had/Were/Did 無法接 be found 形成此結構。

boss.desc: 【語意】The defence rests on a distinction that is formally neat but practically porous. What is being suggested?
options: A. The practical boundary is firmer than the formal definition.
B. The defence has already been withdrawn by its proponents.
C. The categories look clear in principle but are difficult to keep separate in use.
D. The categories are linguistically incoherent and have no definition.
boss.explain: neat 與 porous 對比理論分類清楚、實際界線易被穿越；不是主張毫無定義。

boss.desc: 【語意】The assurance is not so much contradicted by the small print as rendered almost vacuous by it. What is the most precise criticism?
options: A. The qualifications explicitly state the exact opposite of the assurance.
B. The assurance and qualifications concern entirely unrelated services.
C. The small print adds commitments that make the assurance stronger.
D. The qualifications leave the assurance with very little substantive commitment.
boss.explain: vacuous 指實質承諾被條件掏空；句子刻意區分掏空與直接矛盾。

boss.desc: 請唸出：表面中立的措辭
boss.speak: a superficially neutral formulation

boss.desc: 請唸出：解釋不應與正當化混為一談
boss.ans: EXPLANATION SHOULD NOT BE CONFLATED WITH JUSTIFICATION
boss.speak: explanation should not be conflated with justification
boss.vocabId: R8:EXPLANATION SHOULD NOT BE CONFLATED WITH JUSTIFICATION

boss.desc: 請拼出：用以證明無責任或開脫過錯的（E 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.speak: exculpatory

boss.desc: 填空題：E _ I _ I _ N (在論述中省略或略過某部分)
boss.speak: elision

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The language of improvement leaves remarkably little room for those whose lives are being improved against their wishes.
options: A. 說話者反對任何人改善生活的可能。
B. 改善內容已由每位居民共同決定。
C. 改善的語言幾乎沒有容納那些被違背意願地改善生活的人。
D. 所有受影響者都已明確要求同樣的改善。
boss.explain: 反諷指向改善敘事排除當事人意願，不是反對所有改善。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The apparent inevitability of the decision depends on treating a contestable priority as though it were a fixed fact.
options: A. 所有優先順序已由不可改變的自然規律決定。
B. 決定沒有任何理由，只是隨機選出。
C. 說話者已證明所有人反對這個順序。
D. 決定看似必然，是因可爭論的優先順序被當成固定事實。
boss.explain: contestable priority 與 fixed fact 的混淆製造必然感。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The exception has become sufficiently routine that calling it exceptional now serves chiefly to protect the rule from reconsideration.
options: A. 例外已很常見，繼續稱作例外主要是在保護規則免於重新檢視。
B. 例外仍極少發生，因此足以證明規則永遠正確。
C. 規則已被正式廢除，不再影響任何人。
D. 每項例外都已被證明不曾發生。
boss.explain: 例外常態化與標籤維持形成張力，稱呼可讓規則免於反思。

boss.desc: 【修辭】The cost is described as modest without specifying for whom. What is the most relevant objection?
options: A. The cost cannot be stated because it has no numerical value.
B. Calling a cost modest explicitly identifies the poorest payer.
C. Affordability is being implied without a defined point of reference.
D. Every modest cost is necessarily affordable to every person.
boss.explain: modest 是相對評價，缺少對象或基準，便無法支持對所有人的可負擔性暗示。

boss.desc: 【語意】The compromise is equitable only on a curiously truncated view of whose interests count. What is challenged?
options: A. The existence of any compromise between the named parties.
B. The arithmetic used to divide an agreed amount equally.
C. The possibility of discussing interests in public.
D. The restricted set of affected interests used to claim fairness.
boss.explain: truncated view 指考量對象被截短，公平主張可能排除了相關者。

boss.desc: 【語用】The disruption is termed a transitional inconvenience, though no end point is specified and those bearing it cannot leave. What does the label tend to accomplish?
options: A. It frames a potentially enduring burden as temporary and relatively minor.
B. It guarantees a short duration through an explicit commitment.
C. It establishes that all affected people consented to remain.
D. It supplies a measurable deadline for ending the disruption.
boss.explain: transitional 與 inconvenience 淡化時間和強度，而題幹未支持確定短暫或自願承擔。

boss.desc: 請唸出：權力上的不對等
boss.speak: an asymmetry of power

boss.desc: 請唸出：這個框架讓有爭議的優先事項看似自然
boss.ans: THE FRAMING MAKES A CONTESTED PRIORITY APPEAR NATURAL
boss.speak: the framing makes a contested priority appear natural
boss.vocabId: R8:THE FRAMING MAKES A CONTESTED PRIORITY APPEAR NATURAL

boss.desc: 請拼出：把抽象或人為概念當成固定實物的做法（R 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.speak: reification

boss.desc: 填空題：I N C _ M M E _ S U R _ B L E (無法以共同尺度充分比較的)
boss.speak: incommensurable

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Her exposition is lucid, though its lucidity owes something to leaving the hardest case outside the frame.
options: A. 她說明含糊，卻完整處理所有棘手案例。
B. 最棘手案例經她說明後已不再有任何爭議。
C. 說明清楚與案例選取在此被明確區分為完全無關。
D. 她說明清楚，但部分是因最棘手案例被排除。
boss.explain: 肯定清楚並指出清晰外觀的部分來源是範圍選擇。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: It would be pedantic to insist on the distinction if nothing turned on it; the point is that rather a great deal does.
options: A. 若差異不影響任何事，堅持它才是吹毛求疵；但此處它影響很大。
B. 因差異影響很大，所以不值得繼續區分。
C. 說話者承認堅持此差異毫無實際意義。
D. 只要有人提出差異，就不必再證明其重要性。
boss.explain: 反事實條件與後句共同支持這個區分並非無關緊要。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The exercise is productive precisely because it denies the reader the consolation of a vocabulary in which the disagreement has already been settled.
options: A. 練習已把爭議結論明確列出作為提示。
B. 練習有價值，正因不讓讀者靠已預先判定爭議的詞彙獲得安心。
C. 練習因詞彙不足而無法讓讀者辨認任何分歧。
D. 讀者只需背熟標準用語，就能避開所有推理。
boss.explain: 詞彙框架可能預定答案，練習刻意不提供這種捷徑。

boss.desc: 【文法】Were the distinction ___, the apparent contradiction would disappear.
options: A. to maintaining
B. been maintained
C. maintain
D. to be maintained
boss.explain: Were＋主詞＋to be＋過去分詞構成正式假設被動倒裝。

boss.desc: 【立場】The account is sceptical without lapsing into indiscriminate suspicion. What balance is maintained?
options: A. Claims are questioned while differences in evidential support still matter.
B. Every claim is treated as equally untrustworthy.
C. Claims are accepted whenever their authors sound confident.
D. The account avoids questioning anything that has been published.
boss.explain: 有辨別的懷疑仍考量證據差異，不是全面不信。

boss.desc: 【語意】The disagreement survives the clarification, which suggests it was never merely verbal. What follows?
options: A. No further clarification could ever have any value.
B. Making the terms clearer has not removed a substantive difference.
C. Clarifying the terms has proved that the participants use identical reasoning.
D. The disagreement was caused only by pronunciation.
boss.explain: 澄清後分歧仍在，支持不只字面用語之爭；不排除澄清的其他價值。

boss.desc: 請唸出：經得起仔細審視的區分
boss.speak: a distinction that bears scrutiny

boss.desc: 請唸出：分歧在實質而不只在字面
boss.ans: THE DISAGREEMENT IS SUBSTANTIVE RATHER THAN MERELY VERBAL
boss.speak: the disagreement is substantive rather than merely verbal
boss.vocabId: R8:THE DISAGREEMENT IS SUBSTANTIVE RATHER THAN MERELY VERBAL

boss.desc: 請拼出：刻意使知識或議題難以理解的做法（O 開頭，12 個字母）
boss.speak: obscurantism

boss.desc: 填空題：P R _ L _ X _ T Y (表達過度冗長的特性)
boss.speak: prolixity

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The narration is arch, but not quite as knowing as it would have us believe.
options: A. 敘述帶俏皮會意姿態，卻未必如它暗示的那麼通透。
B. 敘述全然天真，從未暗示自己懂得更多。
C. 敘述的通透已由所有事件無條件證實。
D. 說話者只在描述拱門的外形。
boss.explain: arch 在此是帶會意或調侃；not quite...保留其自我呈現。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The scene is sentimental only if we mistake its exposure of a desire for reassurance for an attempt to satisfy that desire.
options: A. 說話者認為揭露欲望必然等於肯定欲望。
B. 只有把揭露求安慰的欲望誤當成滿足它，才會把場景讀成感傷煽情。
C. 場景因明確滿足每個角色的願望而感傷。
D. 場景完全沒有涉及任何安慰的欲望。
boss.explain: 區分呈現某種欲求與提供它所求的慰藉。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The novel allows the consolation of pattern while refusing the stronger consolation of a pattern that explains away the loss.
options: A. 小說拒絕任何模式，因此也不提供任何慰藉。
B. 小說把找出模式等同於對失落作最後定論。
C. 小說提供看見模式的慰藉，卻不讓模式把失落輕易解消。
D. 小說以完整模式證明失落其實不曾發生。
boss.explain: 兩層 consolation 被區分，形式秩序不等於消除失落。

boss.desc: 【文法】Such is the economy of the scene ___ a single hesitation alters its meaning.
options: A. that
B. than
C. as to a
D. whether
boss.explain: Such is...that... 表程度及結果；不能改接 than 或 whether。

boss.desc: 【語用】I am not sure the ambiguity earns its keep. What is the critic questioning?
options: A. Whether ambiguity can ever serve an artistic purpose.
B. Whether the interpretive openness contributes enough to justify its presence.
C. Whether the work permits any ambiguity at all.
D. Whether every reader has reached the same interpretation.
boss.explain: earn its keep 比喻產生足夠作用；不否定所有歧義的價值。

boss.desc: 【語意】The comedy is not a release from the work’s bleakness but one of the means by which that bleakness becomes bearable and more apparent. Which reading preserves both functions?
options: A. Humour makes the bleakness bearable only by concealing its existence.
B. Humour demonstrates that the bleakness was never intended seriously.
C. Humour enables engagement with the bleakness while also sharpening awareness of it.
D. Humour replaces the bleakness with an unrelated optimistic message.
boss.explain: 同時保留可承受與更看得清兩種功能，不能只說稀釋或否定。

boss.desc: 請唸出：巧妙維持的多義狀態
boss.speak: an artfully sustained ambiguity

boss.desc: 請唸出：反覆意象獲得令人不安的新共鳴
boss.ans: THE REPEATED IMAGE ACQUIRES A DISQUIETING NEW RESONANCE
boss.speak: the repeated image acquires a disquieting new resonance
boss.vocabId: R8:THE REPEATED IMAGE ACQUIRES A DISQUIETING NEW RESONANCE

boss.desc: 請拼出：從高昂莊嚴突然落到瑣碎的失調效果（B 開頭，6 個字母）
boss.speak: bathos

boss.desc: 填空題：M _ R _ A _ T (幽默或評論尖刻而有批判力的)
boss.speak: mordant

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The courtesy is impeccable; the latitude it leaves for disagreement is rather less so.
options: A. 說話者否認對話中存在任何禮貌。
B. 禮貌無可挑剔，但留給異議的餘地就沒那麼好。
C. 禮貌不佳，卻給了毫無限制的異議空間。
D. 禮貌已使所有人實質意見一致。
boss.explain: 形式courtesy與實質latitude分開評價。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Her acquiescence is being treated as endorsement, though the alternatives were never made remotely attractive.
options: A. 她完全沒有採取任何行動或回應。
B. 說話者主張所有順從都必定出於強迫。
C. 她的順從被當成支持，但其他選項從未有起碼吸引力。
D. 她已在多個同等可行選項中熱烈支持此案。
boss.explain: 有限可選性使從順從推到積極支持成問題，未泛化所有情況。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The magnanimity of the gesture is easier to appreciate if we forget that the right being graciously restored was not the giver’s to withhold in the first place.
options: A. 給予者原本有明確權利永久剝奪該權利。
B. 恢復權利被描述為與任何恩惠姿態毫無關聯。
C. 說話者主要在稱讚給予者無條件犧牲。
D. 若忘了對方本無權扣留這項權利，恢復權利的姿態才比較像寬宏。
boss.explain: 以原本無權扣留的事物施惠，削弱magnanimity的正當性。

boss.desc: 【文法】Be that ___, the unresolved question of authority remains.
options: A. that it were
B. as it may
C. as it might be it
D. whether may
boss.explain: Be that as it may 是固定讓步語，意為即便如此。

boss.desc: 【範圍】I would not say that the objection is wholly without merit. Which response most closely matches the strength of this assessment?
options: A. It has no validity under any plausible interpretation.
B. It is accepted as decisive solely because it has been raised.
C. It may have some validity, without amounting to an endorsement of the whole objection.
D. It is entirely persuasive and requires no further examination.
boss.explain: 雙重保留只給有限肯定，不可擴大為全盤或決定性支持。

boss.desc: 【語用】Your candour is refreshing, says the supervisor, adding that discretion is also an important quality in anyone seeking promotion. Which interpretation is best supported?
options: A. The supervisor gives an unconditional guarantee that candour will secure promotion.
B. The supervisor explicitly instructs the employee to falsify every report.
C. The statement contains no suggestion that openness may have consequences.
D. Praise for openness is accompanied by an indirect warning about its possible career cost.
boss.explain: 升遷與discretion的補充使稱讚同時帶警告，但未明說必須造假。

boss.desc: 請唸出：刻意展現的恭順姿態
boss.speak: a studied display of deference

boss.desc: 請唸出：真誠動機本身不足以證成結果
boss.ans: SINCERE MOTIVES DO NOT BY THEMSELVES VINDICATE OUTCOMES
boss.speak: sincere motives do not by themselves vindicate outcomes
boss.vocabId: R8:SINCERE MOTIVES DO NOT BY THEMSELVES VINDICATE OUTCOMES

boss.desc: 請拼出：自認優越而傲慢輕蔑的（S 開頭，12 個字母）
boss.speak: supercilious

boss.desc: 填空題：P L _ C _ T _ R Y (以安撫或平息不滿為目的的)
boss.speak: placatory

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The compliment is gracious only if we overlook the low expectation against which it measures the achievement.
options: A. 成就因未被提及而無法成為稱讚對象。
B. 說話者主要質疑成就是否真的發生。
C. 若忽略它以偏低期待衡量成就，這句稱讚才顯得得體。
D. 稱讚已以相同而公平的高標準評價每個人。
boss.explain: 貶低的預期基準可使稱讚帶居高臨下意味。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I can admire her forbearance while wondering how long the relationship can depend on it without becoming lopsided.
options: A. 我認為容忍已使關係永久公平。
B. 我否認她有任何自我克制。
C. 我主張任何關係都不應有一次讓步。
D. 我能欣賞她的容忍，也會問關係長期仰賴它是否會失衡。
boss.explain: 肯定個人特質，同時檢視依賴該特質的關係結構。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: There is a kind of solicitude that leaves the recipient less able to disagree, because disagreement has been made to look like ingratitude.
options: A. 某種關切讓受助者更難反對，因反對被說成不知感恩。
B. 關切已使所有人能毫無壓力表達不同意見。
C. 受助者從未接獲任何幫助卻故意反對。
D. 說話者認定所有關切都一定是操控。
boss.explain: 指出特定形式的關切與反對成本，不泛化所有善意。

boss.desc: 【文法】Not for a moment ___ that the invitation could be refused without consequence.
options: A. had supposed she
B. she did suppose
C. did she suppose
D. she supposed
boss.explain: 否定副詞語置首，倒裝為 did she suppose。

boss.desc: 【立場】Her refusal is unyielding without being punitive. What does the statement separate?
options: A. A desire to punish from an inability to say no.
B. Agreement to the request from any limit on future requests.
C. An unclear answer from an openly hostile one.
D. Firm maintenance of a boundary from an intention to punish.
boss.explain: uncompromising boundary 不必等於以拒絕懲罰對方。

boss.desc: 【語用】I only wanted you to be happy, he says, as though this settled whether he had listened to what she wanted. What is the passage questioning?
options: A. Whether a benevolent aim answers the separate question of attending to another person’s expressed wishes.
B. Whether anyone can sincerely want another person to be happy.
C. Whether she has expressed any wishes at all.
D. Whether happiness is logically incompatible with being listened to.
boss.explain: 善意目標不自動回答是否聽取對方意願，並非否定所有善意。

boss.desc: 請唸出：帶懊惱或苦笑的承認
boss.speak: a rueful acknowledgment

boss.desc: 請唸出：她的沉著不應被誤認為冷漠
boss.ans: HER COMPOSURE SHOULD NOT BE MISTAKEN FOR INDIFFERENCE
boss.speak: her composure should not be mistaken for indifference
boss.vocabId: R8:HER COMPOSURE SHOULD NOT BE MISTAKEN FOR INDIFFERENCE

boss.desc: 請拼出：容易動怒的（I 開頭，9 個字母）
boss.speak: irascible

boss.desc: 填空題：C _ A _ R _ N (因失誤受挫或難堪而生的懊惱)
boss.speak: chagrin

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The undertaking is impressive chiefly in the ingenuity with which it avoids undertaking anything definite.
options: A. 承諾已具體列出每項責任與期限。
B. 說話者只是在稱讚工作規模很大。
C. 承諾因不使用正式詞彙而失效。
D. 這項承諾最醒目的地方，是巧妙避開任何明確承諾。
boss.explain: undertaking 重複形成反諷，焦點在空洞承諾而非規模。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: It is a peculiar form of responsiveness that requires the customer to translate the problem into a category that omits what made it a problem.
options: A. 要求顧客把問題改寫成會漏掉核心的分類，這種回應方式值得質疑。
B. 分類已讓顧客精確保留每個重要面向。
C. 顧客被禁止使用任何既有分類。
D. 說話者認為所有分類都不可能有幫助。
boss.explain: 分類適配可能迫使關鍵內容消失，非一概反分類。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: To call the procedure accessible because anyone may begin it is to overlook the attrition built into what is required to finish it.
options: A. 完成率已證明所有要求都完全沒有必要。
B. 只因人人可開始就稱程序可及，忽略了完成要求內含的流失阻力。
C. 人人已被保證能在相同時間完成程序。
D. 開始程序本身已被禁止。
boss.explain: 起點可進入不等於全程可使用，attrition 指途中流失。

boss.desc: 【文法】Were it not ___ the proviso in the final paragraph, the promise would be unqualified.
options: A. from
B. by
C. with
D. for
boss.explain: Were it not for 是 if it were not for 的倒裝；指出限定條款是保留來源。

boss.desc: 【立場】The process is procedurally immaculate and substantively barren. What is the criticism?
options: A. Formal compliance has produced little meaningful response to the underlying problem.
B. Meaningful redress has been achieved despite minor procedural errors.
C. Neither procedure nor substance has received any attention.
D. The process is rejected solely because it was too informal.
boss.explain: 程序完善不等於實質有用；barren 批評結果空泛。

boss.desc: 【語用】We regret any inconvenience, the message concludes, after treating the specific loss as outside the definition of inconvenience. What does the closing formula fail to do?
options: A. Maintain a polite tone towards the recipient.
B. Recognise the particular harm that the preceding definition has excluded.
C. Supply a general expression of regret in conventional language.
D. Use the word inconvenience in any part of the message.
boss.explain: 形式道歉仍可存在，但未承認被定義排除的具體損失。

boss.desc: 請唸出：巧妙迴避問題的措辭
boss.speak: an artfully evasive formulation

boss.desc: 請唸出：反覆疏漏需要超越偶發的解釋
boss.ans: REPEATED OVERSIGHTS DEMAND AN EXPLANATION BEYOND ACCIDENT
boss.speak: repeated oversights demand an explanation beyond accident
boss.vocabId: R8:REPEATED OVERSIGHTS DEMAND AN EXPLANATION BEYOND ACCIDENT

boss.desc: 請拼出：使原本可清楚理解的事情變模糊（O 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.speak: obfuscation

boss.desc: 填空題：A T _ R _ T _ O N (在持續阻力下逐漸流失或減少)
boss.speak: attrition

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The restoration is celebrated as generosity, although what has been restored was never legitimately the ruler’s to withhold.
options: A. 恢復被讚為慷慨，但被恢復的事物本不應由統治者正當扣留。
B. 統治者已提供全新的特權而非恢復既有權利。
C. 恢復被敘述為完全沒有任何公開慶祝。
D. 說話者只質疑慶祝儀式是否夠盛大。
boss.explain: 既有權利的恢復與任意施惠之間有正當性差別。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The concession is revocable at the very discretion it is supposed to restrain.
options: A. 說話者確認裁量權在讓步前就已不存在。
B. 讓步能由它原本應限制的同一裁量權撤回。
C. 讓步已把裁量權永久交給受保護者。
D. 撤回只能由獨立且共同同意的程序決定。
boss.explain: 制衡措施取決於被制衡權力，穩定性受質疑。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The narrative withholds the easy comfort of a villain who knows he is lying, asking instead how an honest self-image can survive practices that require others not to speak.
options: A. 敘事完全不關心角色對自己的理解。
B. 要求沉默被呈現為誠實形象的充分證據。
C. 敘事不提供明知說謊的簡單反派，而追問誠實自我形象如何與要求他人沉默的做法共存。
D. 故事已證明所有統治者都知道自己在說謊。
boss.explain: 主題在自我理解與壓制行為的張力，而非單純惡意解釋。

boss.desc: 【文法】Seldom ___ a promise whose exceptions were so generously defined.
options: A. had they encountered
B. they had encountered
C. had encountered they
D. they encountered had
boss.explain: Seldom 置首引發過去完成式倒裝。

boss.desc: 【語用】I regret that you have chosen to place yourself beyond our protection. What presupposition does the statement impose?
options: A. Protection is being offered with no conditions.
B. The loss of protection is framed as the recipient’s choice rather than the speaker’s action.
C. The speaker explicitly accepts sole responsibility for withdrawing protection.
D. The recipient has necessarily requested the withdrawal in clear terms.
boss.explain: chosen to place yourself 把撤保責任置於受保者選擇，不證明其真自願。

boss.desc: 【語意】The narrator does not expose the ruler as insincere so much as show how sincerity can coexist with a convenient blindness to the effects of rule. What is the central insight?
options: A. The ruler has no beliefs about the consequences of governing.
B. Sincerity necessarily makes the consequences of rule benign.
C. Genuine conviction need not prevent self-serving failure to recognise consequences.
D. Every expression of conviction is proved knowingly fraudulent.
boss.explain: 把焦點由蓄意不誠轉向真誠與有利自身的盲點可共存。

boss.desc: 請唸出：不容違背的承諾
boss.speak: an inviolable undertaking

boss.desc: 請唸出：忠於字句不能決定是否忠於目的
boss.ans: FIDELITY TO WORDS DOES NOT SETTLE FIDELITY TO PURPOSE
boss.speak: fidelity to words does not settle fidelity to purpose
boss.vocabId: R8:FIDELITY TO WORDS DOES NOT SETTLE FIDELITY TO PURPOSE

boss.desc: 請拼出：正式廢除協議法律或權利安排（A 開頭，8 個字母）
boss.speak: abrogate

boss.desc: 填空題：R E _ O _ A _ L E (可被撤回或取消的)
boss.speak: revocable

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: a piquant dressing
options: A. 經過長時間冷凍的空盤
B. 滋味鮮明、帶刺激感的調味醬
C. 毫無滋味的調味醬
D. 只用於裝飾桌面的布料
boss.explain: piquant 指開胃而鮮明刺激的滋味；dressing 在此是醬汁。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: For all its studied informality, the service leaves you acutely aware that informality is itself part of the performance.
options: A. 服務的正式規則已被全部取消。
B. 說話者只是說餐廳沒有制服。
C. 服務雖刻意呈現輕鬆，卻讓人清楚感到這份輕鬆本身也是表演。
D. 員工完全沒有想過如何呈現服務。
boss.explain: studied 指經設計；批評自然感被表演痕跡削弱。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The critic’s praise is qualified less by reservations about the food than by unease at the cultural hierarchy through which its excellence is made legible.
options: A. 保留完全只關乎食物溫度。
B. 評論者已否認料理有任何優點。
C. 文化認可被描述為完全不涉及價值排序。
D. 評論者的保留較少來自料理本身，而更多來自使其卓越得以被認可的文化階序。
boss.explain: less ... than ... 定位保留來源；legible 比喻能被理解認可。

boss.desc: 【語用】One could scarcely accuse the restaurant of underselling itself. The critic has just quoted its boastful menu. What is implied?
options: A. Its menu has been omitted from the review.
B. Its self-presentation is emphatically promotional.
C. Its descriptions conceal the existence of the restaurant.
D. The critic admires its reluctance to advertise.
boss.explain: 否定 underselling 委婉指出自我吹捧；由 boastful 語境確定反諷方向。

boss.desc: 【立場】The critic resists the inference that difficulty of preparation confers distinction on the result. What is rejected?
options: A. The claim that the dish required any effort.
B. The relevance of the finished dish to its assessment.
C. Treating labour alone as sufficient evidence of culinary merit.
D. The possibility that demanding work can produce excellent food.
boss.explain: 反對以耗工單獨證成品質，不否認耗工可能有價值。

boss.desc: 【短文】A tasting menu explains each course so exhaustively that diners are told what emotional response to have before tasting it. The critic calls the experience interpretively overdetermined. What is the concern?
options: A. The dishes have no descriptions of any kind.
B. The diners must already agree about every flavour.
C. The restaurant is criticised solely for serving too many courses.
D. The framing leaves little room for diners to form an unprescribed response.
boss.explain: overdetermined 在此指解釋框架過強，預設感受而縮小自主體驗空間。

boss.desc: 請唸出：刻意營造的隨興感
boss.speak: a calculated air of spontaneity

boss.desc: 請唸出：單憑新奇不會使料理卓越
boss.ans: NOVELTY ALONE DOES NOT CONFER DISTINCTION ON A DISH
boss.speak: novelty alone does not confer distinction on a dish
boss.vocabId: R8:NOVELTY ALONE DOES NOT CONFER DISTINCTION ON A DISH

boss.desc: 請拼出：極其講究而不易滿足的（F 開頭，10 個字母）
boss.speak: fastidious

boss.desc: 填空題：C O _ E S _ I _ L E (可食用物品的正式或幽默說法)
boss.speak: comestible

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: a scrupulous account
options: A. 只求簡短而省略查核的敘述
B. 完全無法辨讀的字跡
C. 嚴謹細心的敘述
D. 故意捏造的敘述
boss.explain: scrupulous 表細心嚴守準確等標準。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The anomaly may expose a weakness in the category, or merely a limitation in the observation; the report prematurely settles on the latter.
options: A. 報告已全面比較並排除所有解釋。
B. 說話者斷言分類必須立即廢除。
C. 異常被描述為完全符合既有預期。
D. 異常可能暴露分類弱點，也可能只是觀察限制；報告過早選定後者。
boss.explain: the latter 指觀察限制；批評過早排除另一可能。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: There is a difference between acknowledging that a category is constructed and assuming that it is therefore arbitrary; the report slides from one to the other.
options: A. 分類經建構不表示它任意，報告卻混淆這兩種判斷。
B. 分類只要有根據就不算建構，報告卻未否定建構性。
C. 分類既由人建構就需隨意更改，報告卻固定使用它。
D. 分類未必是任意的，因此報告已證明它完全非人為。
boss.explain: constructed 不必 arbitrary；兩者之間需另有論證。

boss.desc: 【語域】Which expression most clearly signals a deliberately cautious interpretation rather than a categorical finding?
options: A. The hypothesis is now beyond dispute.
B. No alternative account remains possible.
C. The observations lend qualified support to the hypothesis.
D. The observations conclusively establish the hypothesis.
boss.explain: qualified support 為有保留的支持；其餘排除不確定。

boss.desc: 【語意】The observer’s hesitation is epistemic rather than logistical. Which question concerns that hesitation?
options: A. How will the equipment be carried uphill?
B. Where should the group leave its vehicle?
C. Who will distribute the lunch supplies?
D. What does the evidence entitle us to claim?
boss.explain: epistemic 涉及知識與可知程度，logistical 涉及安排執行。

boss.desc: 【語用】The report’s caveats are so diligently confined to footnotes that its headline acquires a confidence the evidence never quite possesses. What is implied?
options: A. The hierarchy of presentation lets the headline imply unwarranted confidence.
B. The care taken over the footnotes makes the headline’s confidence justified.
C. The headline’s confidence is warranted, but the footnotes are unduly hesitant.
D. The qualifications undermine the evidence because they appear so prominently.
boss.explain: 資訊層級使讀者先接收過強確定性；非否定註腳本身。

boss.desc: 請唸出：欠缺根據地將抽象概念當作實體
boss.speak: an unwarranted reification

boss.desc: 請唸出：表面確認反映搜尋中預設的期待
boss.ans: THE APPARENT CONFIRMATION REFLECTS EXPECTATIONS BUILT INTO THE SEARCH
boss.speak: the apparent confirmation reflects expectations built into the search
boss.vocabId: R8:THE APPARENT CONFIRMATION REFLECTS EXPECTATIONS BUILT INTO THE SEARCH

boss.desc: 請拼出：無法僅靠現有證據唯一確定的（U 開頭，15 個字母）
boss.speak: underdetermined

boss.desc: 填空題：I N C _ M M E _ S U R _ B L E (缺乏共同尺度而無法直接相比的)
boss.speak: incommensurable

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: a partisan account
options: A. 平均分配篇幅就必然中立的敘述
B. 只介紹比賽地點的資訊
C. 完全不涉及立場的計分表
D. 偏向所支持一方的敘述
boss.explain: partisan 指偏向一方；篇幅平均亦不自動中立。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The rule’s admirers call it impartial because it is worded uniformly, rather than because they have examined whom it disadvantages.
options: A. 支持者因措辭一致稱規則公正，而非因檢查了誰受不利影響。
B. 支持者已比較各方影響後才認定規則公正。
C. 說話者認為規則必須對每個人寫不同文字。
D. 規則已被承認專為某位參賽者量身訂定。
boss.explain: 形式一致與實質影響不同；不預先斷言規則必不公。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: He invokes the spirit of the game with an eloquence that would be more persuasive had he shown comparable concern when the disputed tactic favoured his side.
options: A. 有爭議招數曾有利對方，所以他現在首次提出反對。
B. 他雄辯訴諸遊戲精神，但若先前招數有利己方時也同樣在意，會更有說服力。
C. 他一貫關心同一招數，因此這次雄辯更有說服力。
D. 說話者因他措辭優美而不再考慮先前立場。
boss.explain: 反事實條件點出立場一致性的欠缺，不單批評說話技巧。

boss.desc: 【語意】The captain’s equanimity survived the defeat. What remained?
options: A. A conviction that the official result would be reversed.
B. A reluctance to admit that the match had ended.
C. An expectation that the next opponent would be weaker.
D. An evenness of temper despite an unwelcome outcome.
boss.explain: equanimity 指面對起伏仍平靜沉著，不是改判信念。

boss.desc: 【文法】The rule was intended to curb precisely the behaviour ___ it is now invoked to excuse.
options: A. that
B. whose
C. where
D. of which
boss.explain: behaviour 作 excuse 受詞，關係代名詞 that；precisely 強調原針對的就是此行為。

boss.desc: 【語意】The memoir refuses the consolation of treating every defeat as a lesson whose value retrospectively justifies it. What is withheld?
options: A. The admission that a result can matter to someone after a match has ended.
B. The assurance that an unhappy outcome must acquire redeeming value through later learning.
C. The possibility that any player might learn something useful after a defeat.
D. The distinction between remembering a defeat and reporting it when it occurred.
boss.explain: 拒絕每次失敗都被學習價值救贖的必然敘事，不否認可能學到。

boss.desc: 請唸出：替自己卸責的敘事
boss.speak: a self exculpatory narrative

boss.desc: 請唸出：同種招數應接受相同判準
boss.ans: THE SAME TACTIC SHOULD INVITE THE SAME STANDARD OF JUDGEMENT
boss.speak: the same tactic should invite the same standard of judgement
boss.vocabId: R8:THE SAME TACTIC SHOULD INVITE THE SAME STANDARD OF JUDGEMENT

boss.desc: 請拼出：以勝利炫耀優越而自滿的（T 開頭，12 個字母）
boss.speak: triumphalist

boss.desc: 填空題：V I _ D I _ T _ V E (懷有報復心而想使人受苦的)
boss.speak: vindictive

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: a perfunctory retraction
options: A. 敷衍而未充分處理問題的撤回
B. 充分查核後提出的新指控
C. 含詳細理由的全面道歉
D. 尚未發表便決定刪去的草稿
boss.explain: perfunctory 表草率例行而欠用心。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The correction is admirably precise about the error and notably imprecise about how far the original conclusion depended on it.
options: A. 說話者肯定修正內容完整，只批評採用的語言難以閱讀。
B. 修正說清了哪項資訊有誤，卻模糊處理原結論受影響的程度。
C. 修正已詳細交代結論如何改變，卻未指出哪項資訊有誤。
D. 修正雖不精確，仍已清楚證明原結論不依賴錯誤資訊。
boss.explain: 交代錯誤與重評它對推論的影響是兩回事。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: What is offered as an explanation of the misunderstanding subtly becomes a prescription for how the audience ought to have understood the message in the first place.
options: A. 觀眾已同意誤會原因，只要求作者重寫當初應採用的訊息內容。
B. 說話者認為作者只是描述誤會發生過程，並未要求任何特定解讀。
C. 原本對誤會如何發生的解釋，悄悄成為對觀眾當初應如何理解的要求。
D. 作者原本要求觀眾依指定方式理解，後來才承認其他解讀也合理。
boss.explain: 由描述如何誤解滑向規範應如何理解，話語功能改變。

boss.desc: 【字彙】A disingenuous reply is one that ___.
options: A. affects candour while withholding what the speaker knows to be relevant
B. openly acknowledges uncertainty about information the speaker lacks
C. uses unfamiliar terminology while attempting to explain a difficult subject
D. declines to answer and explicitly gives the reason for doing so
boss.explain: disingenuous 涉裝作坦誠或無知，非單純術語複雜或公開拒答。

boss.desc: 【文法】The speaker objected to the certainty with ___ her remarks had been reported.
options: A. whose
B. which
C. that
D. whom
boss.explain: with which 表報導以何種確定程度；介系詞後用 which。

boss.desc: 【立場】The essay locates the bias less in what the report asserts than in what it renders unremarkable. What is the focus?
options: A. The failure to give ordinary events a sufficiently dramatic headline.
B. The number of explicit opinions expressed by named contributors.
C. Assumptions made to seem natural rather than claims stated openly.
D. Factual inaccuracies in the report’s most prominent direct assertions.
boss.explain: renders unremarkable 指使某些前提不被當作值得質疑，非誇張不夠。

boss.desc: 請唸出：巧妙限定範圍的否認
boss.speak: an artfully circumscribed denial

boss.desc: 請唸出：精確引文可能被置於偏頗框架
boss.ans: A PRECISE QUOTATION CAN ACQUIRE A TENDENTIOUS FRAMING
boss.speak: a precise quotation can acquire a tendentious framing
boss.vocabId: R8:A PRECISE QUOTATION CAN ACQUIRE A TENDENTIOUS FRAMING

boss.desc: 請拼出：以含糊措辭迴避明確立場的做法（E 開頭，12 個字母）
boss.speak: equivocation

boss.desc: 填空題：E X _ U _ G _ T E (刪除作品中被認為不宜的內容)
boss.speak: expurgate

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: a grudging concession
options: A. 經眾人一致讚賞的提案
B. 不太情願地作出的讓步
C. 主動熱情提出的額外贈與
D. 私下撤回而未告知的承諾
boss.explain: grudging 指勉強不情願，concession 為讓步。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The compromise is not especially elegant, but its inelegance is partly what permits several incompatible preferences to coexist.
options: A. 不相容偏好使折衷毫無作用，所以應立即恢復原狀。
B. 說話者認為折衷的價值僅在改善室內視覺一致性。
C. 折衷不算優雅，但這種不整齊正容納了不同偏好。
D. 折衷之所以優雅，是因為所有人已放棄原先偏好。
boss.explain: 視覺不完美可來自容納差異，非自動失敗。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The dispute would be easier to resolve if each side did not present its preferred inconvenience as the natural condition to which the other ought to adapt.
options: A. 雙方已承認各自偏好都有代價，只是仍無法決定哪方先讓步。
B. 只要其中一方證明自己較常待在家，就能確定自然應由對方適應。
C. 爭議只在如何稱呼不便，雙方對實際安排及適應責任已完全一致。
D. 若雙方不把自己偏好的不便當成對方理應適應的自然狀態，較容易解決爭議。
boss.explain: 將偏好自然化會阻礙協商，反事實條件暗示目前雙方都有此問題。

boss.desc: 【字彙】A dilapidated building is one that ___.
options: A. has been deliberately left undecorated for flexible use
B. has deteriorated through age or neglect
C. has been newly built in a traditional style
D. has an unconventional but carefully maintained layout
boss.explain: dilapidated 是年久或失修而破敗，不是簡約或特殊格局。

boss.desc: 【文法】The arrangement leaves the least space to those ___ possessions are most difficult to store.
options: A. which
B. who their
C. whose
D. whom
boss.explain: whose possessions 表所有格；those 指人。

boss.desc: 【短文】A resident calls every object she dislikes clutter and every object she values character. Another resident asks for criteria they could both apply. What is sought?
options: A. A complete removal of objects with sentimental value.
B. A way to count objects without discussing their uses.
C. A rule allowing whoever speaks first to decide the labels.
D. A standard less dependent on one person’s preferences.
boss.explain: 要求可共同適用的判準，不等於禁止情感物或只計數。

boss.desc: 請唸出：把共用空間視為自己所有的主張
boss.ans: A PROPRIETARY CLAIM OVER SHARED SPACE
boss.speak: a proprietary claim over shared space
boss.vocabId: R8:A PROPRIETARY CLAIM OVER SHARED SPACE

boss.desc: 請唸出：共有不只需要沒有個人物品
boss.ans: SHARED OWNERSHIP REQUIRES MORE THAN THE ABSENCE OF PERSONAL BELONGINGS
boss.speak: shared ownership requires more than the absence of personal belongings
boss.vocabId: R8:SHARED OWNERSHIP REQUIRES MORE THAN THE ABSENCE OF PERSONAL BELONGINGS

boss.desc: 請拼出：顯示把事物當成自己所有的（P 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.speak: proprietary

boss.desc: 填空題：I N T _ A N _ I G _ N T (拒絕妥協而不肯改變的)
boss.speak: intransigent

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: a sinecure in name only
options: A. 無工作也無報酬的志工機會
B. 確定人人願意接手的輕鬆職位
C. 名為閒職卻實際不清閒的職位
D. 連名稱都不存在的虛構工作
boss.explain: in name only 限於名義，實質未符合 sinecure。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The appeal to community becomes less persuasive when the costs of sustaining it fall predictably on the same few people.
options: A. 只要由固定少數人承擔代價，社群精神就更有說服力。
B. 成本已有公平輪替，所以訴求社群不再必要。
C. 說話者認為社群一詞只能用於沒有任何成本的活動。
D. 維繫社群代價總落同幾人時，社群訴求較難服人。
boss.explain: 批評持續不均的負擔，非否定社群或所有固定角色。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: To call the labour voluntary answers the question of formal compulsion without settling the subtler question of what it costs a person to refuse.
options: A. 稱勞動自願只回答形式強迫，未解決拒絕的隱性代價。
B. 自願一詞已足以證明拒絕不會帶來任何人際負擔。
C. 說話者認為所有自願勞動在正式規定上都屬強迫。
D. 拒絕的代價已被量化，所以形式自願不再有任何意義。
boss.explain: 形式同意與社會壓力成本可分開檢視。

boss.desc: 【字彙】A sinecure is a position that ___.
options: A. exists only until another employee returns
B. requires its holder to mediate between rival groups
C. provides income or status while requiring little work
D. demands intense work without offering recognition
boss.explain: sinecure 指閒職，常帶貶義，不是吃力不討好職。

boss.desc: 【語用】The chair praises the volunteers’ boundless energy while repeatedly declining to define the limits of their responsibilities. What relation deserves scrutiny?
options: A. Praise establishes that volunteers have agreed to every additional task.
B. The chair’s praise is intended solely to describe physical fitness.
C. The volunteers’ responsibilities have been reduced because their energy is praised.
D. Praise may normalise an expectation of unlimited availability.
boss.explain: boundless rhetoric 可能讓無限付出被當理所當然，非已明示同意。

boss.desc: 【語用】The event is described as co-created, though the invitation to create arrives only after the decisions that shape possible contributions have been made. What is the qualification?
options: A. Participation is invited within a framework participants had no part in setting.
B. Participants have been asked to decide every element without any organising support.
C. The event’s framework is still open because its publicity uses the term co-created.
D. The organisers have promised to discard the framework once contributions arrive.
boss.explain: 共創範圍受先定框架限制，不等於全無貢獻空間。

boss.desc: 請唸出：未被量化的備援勞動力
boss.speak: an unquantified reserve of labour

boss.desc: 請唸出：框架可能限制參與者實際可作的貢獻
boss.ans: A FRAMEWORK MAY CONSTRAIN WHAT PARTICIPANTS CAN MEANINGFULLY CONTRIBUTE
boss.speak: a framework may constrain what participants can meaningfully contribute
boss.vocabId: R8:A FRAMEWORK MAY CONSTRAIN WHAT PARTICIPANTS CAN MEANINGFULLY CONTRIBUTE

boss.desc: 請拼出：持續努力而似不知疲倦的（I 開頭，13 個字母）
boss.speak: indefatigable

boss.desc: 填空題：I N _ Q U _ T A _ L E (分配或對待不公平的)
boss.speak: inequitable

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The room’s air of timelessness is an achievement of conservation, not evidence that time has somehow passed it by.
options: A. 房間從未經保存，所以時間對它沒有影響。
B. 保存工作已把所有物件的實際年代改成同一年。
C. 說話者認為只要物件古老，房間就必然顯得永恆。
D. 房間的永恆感靠保存工作達成，不是時間真的沒留下作用。
boss.explain: 表象為工作成果，不是沒有變化的直接證據。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The fascination lies not in a pristine original but in the palimpsest of repairs through which the object remained useful.
options: A. 迷人處不是無瑕原貌，而是讓物件持續有用的層疊修補。
B. 迷人處是所有修補都已移除而還原無瑕原件。
C. 修補紀錄之所以重要，只因能提高古物出售價格。
D. 說話者認為實用物件一旦修補就不能再被收藏。
boss.explain: palimpsest 借喻多層改動可讀為歷史，不只是原貌。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The survivor’s authority is not absolute: what remains can testify to the past while also reflecting the decisions that allowed this object, and not another, to survive.
options: A. 說話者在比較親歷者與物件，已決定只相信親歷者的口述。
B. 留存物可見證過去，也反映為何留它而非他物的選擇，證據權威非絕對。
C. 物件留存已保證它代表所有未留存物，無需檢視選擇過程。
D. 只要留存涉及選擇，物件便不可能提供任何過往資訊。
boss.explain: 留存證據與保存選擇偏差並存，不等於證據全無效。

boss.desc: 【字彙】A vestige is ___.
options: A. a complete replacement for a damaged original
B. a future addition announced before it is made
C. an exact measurement taken during restoration
D. a surviving trace of something largely gone
boss.explain: vestige 是殘留痕跡，非完整重建。

boss.desc: 【文法】The story lends the object an importance it would not otherwise ___.
options: A. possess
B. possessed
C. to possess
D. having possessed
boss.explain: would not 後接原形 possess；otherwise 指若無該故事。

boss.desc: 【短文】A cracked cup is presented as a universal symbol of family life. A donor notes that it belonged to a worker who lived alone and used it at night shifts. What is at risk in the universal framing?
options: A. The cup’s damage has made its physical function impossible to reconstruct.
B. A general emotional theme may eclipse the particular life the object records.
C. A specific ownership history necessarily prevents any visitor from relating to the cup.
D. The donor’s account proves that workers cannot form relationships outside the home.
boss.explain: 普遍共鳴可能蓋掉具體人物差異，不表示無法產生任何共鳴。

boss.desc: 請唸出：事後賦予敘事的連貫性
boss.speak: a retrospective narrative coherence

boss.desc: 請唸出：普遍比喻可能遮掩具體人生
boss.ans: A UNIVERSAL METAPHOR MAY OBSCURE A PARTICULAR LIFE
boss.speak: a universal metaphor may obscure a particular life
boss.vocabId: R8:A UNIVERSAL METAPHOR MAY OBSCURE A PARTICULAR LIFE

boss.desc: 請拼出：回顧過往而作的（R 開頭，13 個字母）
boss.speak: retrospective

boss.desc: 填空題：C O _ M E _ O R _ T E (以特定行動保存對人或事的紀念)
boss.speak: commemorate

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: His apology was so eloquent that one almost forgot how carefully it avoided naming what he had done.
options: A. 道歉雄辯到讓人幾乎忘了它謹慎避說所作何事。
B. 他詳細說明所作何事，因此道歉不需任何修辭。
C. 他道歉太簡短，所以每個人都立刻指出問題。
D. 說話者確認他根本沒有開口向任何人道歉。
boss.explain: 語言技巧可能掩蓋未承認具體行為。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: He is punctilious about giving everyone a choice, less so about allowing a choice he would not himself have made.
options: A. 他把全部決策交給別人，從不表達自身偏好。
B. 他細心給人選擇，卻較不能容許別人選他不會選的答案。
C. 他根本不提供選擇，所以沒有任何表面自由。
D. 他接受每種答案，只對選擇過程的禮節有疑問。
boss.explain: 提供形式選擇與容忍實際分歧不同。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: What passes for forgiveness in the final exchange may be no more than a mutually convenient agreement not to specify what remains unforgiven.
options: A. 說話者確定兩人從未有過分歧，所以不需原諒。
B. 雙方已明確宣布永不見面，且沒有任何方便安排。
C. 最後互動看似原諒，也可能只是雙方方便地不說明尚未原諒之事。
D. 最後互動已列明所有過錯，且雙方確認完全原諒。
boss.explain: may 保留表面和解背後的迴避解釋，不確證永不原諒。

boss.desc: 【字彙】An arch remark is typically ___.
options: A. knowingly playful or teasing rather than straightforward
B. structurally complex because it describes an old building
C. angrily direct and indifferent to the listener’s response
D. so obscure that the speaker does not understand it
boss.explain: arch 用於語氣可指故作俏皮、狡黠，不是建築拱形。

boss.desc: 【文法】The pleasure he took in appearing reluctant was greater than ___ he took in refusing.
options: A. whose
B. that
C. what
D. which
boss.explain: that 代替前述 pleasure，作比較對象。

boss.desc: 【短文】A story ends with an apology accepted aloud and a cup quietly moved beyond the visitor’s reach. What does the paired action permit the reader to infer?
options: A. The visitor has explicitly asked the host to move the cup.
B. The apology concerned only where the cup should be placed.
C. Verbal reconciliation may coexist with a residual lack of trust.
D. Acceptance has necessarily restored the relationship to its former state.
boss.explain: 口頭接受與防範動作並存，may 不確證犯罪或未來破裂。

boss.desc: 請唸出：以隆重姿態展現的慷慨
boss.speak: a ceremonious show of generosity

boss.desc: 請唸出：避談主題反使它更難被忽略
boss.ans: AVOIDING THE SUBJECT MAKES ITS PRESENCE HARDER TO IGNORE
boss.speak: avoiding the subject makes its presence harder to ignore
boss.vocabId: R8:AVOIDING THE SUBJECT MAKES ITS PRESENCE HARDER TO IGNORE

boss.desc: 請拼出：幽默或批評尖銳帶諷刺的（M 開頭，7 個字母）
boss.speak: mordant

boss.desc: 填空題：U N _ P _ R _ N G (批評或揭露時不留情面的)
boss.speak: unsparing

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The permission is conditional, although the condition does not by itself require you to take the permitted action.
options: A. 說話者確認條件尚未成立，因此行動已永遠不准進行。
B. 許可是有條件的，但條件成立不表示你必須採取該行動。
C. 條件一成立，原先許可就自動變成必須執行的義務。
D. 許可不附條件，所有條件都只對禁止行為適用。
boss.explain: 有條件准做與必須做不同，不能把許可推成義務。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The manual silently transfers a judgement from the designer to the user, while retaining the tone of a procedure that leaves nothing to judgement.
options: A. 設計者已替使用者完成全部判斷，只剩機械重複。
B. 說話者反對使用者在任何情況作出自主決定。
C. 手冊暗中把判斷交給使用者，語氣卻像完全不需裁量。
D. 手冊明白標出所有判斷點，所以使用者知道何時選擇。
boss.explain: 隱藏需要判斷處與無裁量表象之落差。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: An instruction can be formally complete and pragmatically inadequate if following it requires knowing which of its stated steps do not apply here.
options: A. 指示只要形式完整，就足以保證任何人能判斷所有例外。
B. 所有步驟在本例都已被明示適用，使用者只需依序操作。
C. 說話者認為完整指示的字數必須少於未完整指示。
D. 若使用者仍需知道本例哪些步驟不適用，形式完整仍可能實用不足。
boss.explain: 有列步驟不等於交代適用判斷，形式/語用充分性不同。

boss.desc: 【字彙】A stipulation is ___.
options: A. a preliminary guess made without specifying what would follow
B. a condition explicitly required as part of an agreement or instruction
C. an accidental result noticed only after a procedure has finished
D. an illustration whose details have no connection with the procedure
boss.explain: stipulation 是明定條件，不是事後結果。

boss.desc: 【文法】So far from ___ the ambiguity, the added example reproduces it in another form.
options: A. to resolve
B. having resolve
C. resolving
D. resolved
boss.explain: So far from + 動名詞 ... 表非但未解決反而重現。

boss.desc: 【語用】An expert calls the procedure intuitive after supplying, without noticing, several judgements the instructions never articulate. What should be considered?
options: A. The expert’s success proves that no additional judgement was involved.
B. The instructions must be clear because an experienced user followed them.
C. A procedure cannot be described in language if any judgement is required.
D. Tacit expertise may be doing work attributed to the instructions’ clarity.
boss.explain: 成功可能靠內隱知識補洞，不能直接代表新手可用。

boss.desc: 請唸出：實際使用情境中不夠充分的指示
boss.speak: a pragmatically inadequate instruction

boss.desc: 請唸出：功能決定微小偏差是否重要
boss.ans: THE FUNCTION DETERMINES WHETHER A SMALL DEVIATION MATTERS
boss.speak: the function determines whether a small deviation matters
boss.vocabId: R8:THE FUNCTION DETERMINES WHETHER A SMALL DEVIATION MATTERS

boss.desc: 請拼出：尚未能唯一確定的狀態（I 開頭，13 個字母）
boss.speak: indeterminacy

boss.desc: 填空題：E X H _ U S T _ V E _ E S S (將相關項目完全涵蓋的性質)
boss.speak: exhaustiveness

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The route is direct only from the starting point the designer has silently privileged.
options: A. 路線直接與否只由終點決定，與起點無關。
B. 說話者認為設計者不准任何人另選起點。
C. 路線只對設計者默默優先考量的起點直接。
D. 設計者已比較所有起點，確認同一條路都最短。
boss.explain: privileged 指預設優先而非明令禁止其他起點。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: To demonstrate that the route can be used is not yet to demonstrate that it can be discovered by someone who does not already know it.
options: A. 路線既能用，就已保證不熟悉者可輕鬆發現。
B. 說話者認為發現路線與使用路線毫無任何關係。
C. 只有熟客可用，所以路線已被正式禁止新客進入。
D. 證明路能用，未證明不熟悉者能找到它。
boss.explain: 可使用與可發現是不同可用性面向。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The criticism is not that a common entrance is impossible, but that calling it common cannot by itself erase the unequal effort required to reach it.
options: A. 批評不是共用入口不可能，而是稱共用不能抹去抵達負擔差異。
B. 既然入口共用，各人抵達負擔就已被證明相同。
C. 批評要求為每個人另建入口，不容任何共享安排。
D. 說話者只在比較各入口名字是否使用相同詞彙。
boss.explain: 名稱與實際負擔區別，不預定共享失敗。

boss.desc: 【字彙】An inscrutable layout is one that ___.
options: A. has no physical boundary around its exterior
B. is easy to recognise from every possible viewpoint
C. resists ready understanding or interpretation
D. has been measured with exceptional precision
boss.explain: inscrutable 難理解，不必不可物理通行。

boss.desc: 【指涉】The criticism concerns the alternative’s discoverability, not its existence. Which response misses the point?
options: A. Testing whether newcomers can locate the alternative without staff prompting.
B. Comparing the visibility of the alternative with that of the default route.
C. Asking visitors which words they use when searching for the alternative.
D. Showing that the alternative exists without explaining how newcomers find it.
boss.explain: 只證明有替代方案不能回應怎麼發現它，其他皆直接相關。

boss.desc: 【短文】A centre cites satisfied users of its digital entrance system as evidence that alternative access is unnecessary. The survey excludes people who abandoned the process before entry. What limits the conclusion?
options: A. It assesses those who passed a threshold while omitting those deterred by it.
B. It includes users of digital access without asking them to rate the building’s architecture.
C. It compares satisfaction at different times without changing the wording of the survey.
D. It records satisfaction rather than the exact number of screens shown to each person.
boss.explain: 成功進入者樣本排除門檻阻卻者，不能外推替代無需。

boss.desc: 請唸出：表面上適用所有人的設施安排
boss.speak: an ostensibly universal provision

boss.desc: 請唸出：放棄嘗試可能揭露成功到訪掩蓋的界限
boss.ans: ABANDONED ATTEMPTS MAY REVEAL LIMITS THAT SUCCESSFUL VISITS CONCEAL
boss.speak: abandoned attempts may reveal limits that successful visits conceal
boss.vocabId: R8:ABANDONED ATTEMPTS MAY REVEAL LIMITS THAT SUCCESSFUL VISITS CONCEAL

boss.desc: 請拼出：使某觀點或需求獲得優先地位（P 開頭，9 個字母）
boss.speak: privilege

boss.desc: 填空題：P R _ S U _ P T _ V E (以尚未確定的假設為基礎的)
boss.speak: presumptive

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The pause is full of possibility until the music tells us, rather too insistently, which possibility we are meant to choose.
options: A. 音樂擴大所有可能，讓停頓完全無法被解讀。
B. 停頓已沒有任何意義，音樂只是填補技術故障。
C. 說話者確認觀眾已自行同意唯一可能後才出現音樂。
D. 停頓本有多種可能，音樂卻過度堅持指定該選哪種。
boss.explain: 批評配樂過度限定詮釋，非停頓原來無義。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The scene approaches sentimentality, then the oddly practical final line pulls it back from asking us to admire our own tenderness.
options: A. 場景接近濫情，最後務實台詞卻把它拉回，免得只顧自我感動。
B. 最後務實台詞使場景更要求觀眾誇讚自己溫柔。
C. 場景從未有任何情感，因此最後才需要加上煽情句。
D. 說話者只在比較最後台詞字數是否比前一句長。
boss.explain: practical interruption 節制自我感傷，情感未必全被取消。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The ending offers recognition rather than resolution, leaving us to understand the characters more fully without pretending their predicament has become any easier.
options: A. 結尾完全不提供任何新理解，只重複開場資訊。
B. 結尾提供理解而非解決，更懂角色卻不假裝困境已變容易。
C. 結尾解決困境，所以不再需要理解人物的處境。
D. 角色困境變容易只因觀眾不再知道先前發生何事。
boss.explain: recognition 洞察與resolution 解決區分，非純資訊缺失。

boss.desc: 【字彙】An anticlimax is ___.
options: A. a sudden increase in intensity after a restrained opening
B. a deliberately repeated line that gains significance each time
C. a pause used to let an audience absorb an important event
D. an ending or turn that falls below the expectation built up beforehand
boss.explain: anticlimax 前面鋪陳後落差失望，不是所有低調結尾必然失敗。

boss.desc: 【指涉】The review faults the direction’s insistence on emotion, not the actors’ capacity to convey it. What is being criticised?
options: A. The demand that feeling be continually emphasised.
B. The performers’ inability to express any feeling convincingly.
C. The audience’s refusal to interpret a restrained gesture.
D. The use of dialogue rather than silent movement.
boss.explain: 批評導演過度強調情緒，不是演員能力不足。

boss.desc: 【短文】The final gesture repeats an earlier one, but the character now knows what the audience knew from the start. Why might the repetition carry a different force?
options: A. The character’s new knowledge removes every ambiguity from the whole production.
B. The changed distribution of knowledge alters the gesture’s dramatic meaning.
C. The gesture’s meaning depends only on whether its physical shape is identical.
D. The audience must forget the earlier scene to understand the final gesture.
boss.explain: 知識配置變化改變相同動作的詮釋，非全劇歧義盡除。

boss.desc: 請唸出：帶脆弱感的確定宣示
boss.speak: a brittle assertion of certainty

boss.desc: 請唸出：角色知道更多時重複動作的作用會改變
boss.ans: A REPEATED GESTURE CHANGES FORCE WHEN THE CHARACTER KNOWS MORE
boss.speak: a repeated gesture changes force when the character knows more
boss.vocabId: R8:A REPEATED GESTURE CHANGES FORCE WHEN THE CHARACTER KNOWS MORE

boss.desc: 請拼出：鋪陳期待後不如預期的收尾或轉折（A 開頭，10 個字母）
boss.speak: anticlimax

boss.desc: 填空題：S E N _ I M E _ T A _ I T Y (過分感傷而偏離實際的情感表現)
boss.speak: sentimentality

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The signature is affectionate; the sentence immediately above it is almost contractual in its insistence on what has and has not been promised.
options: A. 署名溫情，上一句卻近似契約般精確劃定承諾。
B. 上一句熱烈承諾一切，署名則完全沒有情感。
C. 整封信使用同樣溫情語氣，不區分任何承諾範圍。
D. 說話者確認信件已構成特定法律制度下的有效契約。
boss.explain: 語氣反差是比喻，不判斷真實法律效力。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: A scrupulously conditional sentence can still be heard as a promise if the warmth around it encourages the recipient to overlook the condition.
options: A. 說話者認為所有溫暖措辭都構成蓄意欺騙。
B. 即使條件句精確，周圍溫情使人忽略條件時仍可能被當承諾。
C. 條件只要文法正確，收件者就不可能誤讀為承諾。
D. 訊息已把條件正式取消，所以溫情不再影響理解。
boss.explain: 字面限定與整體語用效果可能不一致，can 非必然。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: An invitation to speak freely is qualified not by an explicit ban but by the elaborate account of the hurt an unwelcome answer would supposedly cause.
options: A. 傷害已發生且證實與回答無關，雙方只是共同回顧。
B. 說話者認為只要沒有正式禁令，言說就不會有壓力。
C. 暢所欲言邀請不是靠禁令限制，而是詳述不受歡迎答案將造成的傷害。
D. 明文禁止已列出所有不可說的答案，因此不需任何暗示。
boss.explain: 社會情感代價可限制形式言論自由，supposedly 保留對預告傷害的距離。

boss.desc: 【字彙】An importunate correspondent is one who ___.
options: A. presses requests persistently to the point of being troublesome
B. writes infrequently because every word is carefully chosen
C. avoids making any request that might inconvenience another person
D. fails to receive replies because the address is incomplete
boss.explain: importunate 指纏求不休，不是信件進口。

boss.desc: 【指涉】I do not dispute that you meant to help; I dispute that helping entitled you to make that choice for me. What is contested?
options: A. The fact that the recipient explicitly requested assistance.
B. The authority claimed on the basis of helpful intent.
C. The assertion that the writer had any choice to make.
D. The possibility that helping can ever benefit another person.
boss.explain: 否定焦點是善意是否授權代決，不是否定善意可能。

boss.desc: 【短文】The letter ends, You will, I know, understand why I cannot explain further. A reader notes that understanding is invoked precisely where the information needed for it is withheld. What is the effect?
options: A. The reader is asked only to check whether the letter arrived intact.
B. The writer explicitly invites a detailed challenge to every omitted point.
C. Assumed sympathy substitutes for an explanation that would enable informed judgement.
D. The writer supplies an exhaustive explanation and then requests confirmation.
boss.explain: 預設體諒可封住追問，不能直接當已有理解的證據。

boss.desc: 請唸出：雙方可直接表態程度的不對稱
boss.speak: an asymmetry of permissible directness

boss.desc: 請唸出：預設體諒不能代替決策說明
boss.ans: ASSUMED SYMPATHY CANNOT REPLACE AN EXPLANATION OF THE DECISION
boss.speak: assumed sympathy cannot replace an explanation of the decision
boss.vocabId: R8:ASSUMED SYMPATHY CANNOT REPLACE AN EXPLANATION OF THE DECISION

boss.desc: 請拼出：用迂迴冗長措辭表達的（C 開頭，14 個字母）
boss.speak: circumlocutory

boss.desc: 填空題：P R E _ U M _ T U _ U S (未有權限或未經同意就冒昧行事的)
boss.speak: presumptuous

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The brightness is almost estranging: familiar objects acquire edges that make them look newly invented.
options: A. 說話者只是確認物件製造日期在當天。
B. 亮光幾乎讓熟物變陌生，輪廓鮮明得像新造出來。
C. 熟物因光太暗而完全看不見，故無從認出。
D. 物件已被人全部換新，所以才出現不同輪廓。
boss.explain: estranging陌生化是觀感，非實物替換證據。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The scene is not quite consoling; its beauty seems indifferent to whether the observer has any use for consolation.
options: A. 說話者因未受安慰便否定景物有任何美感。
B. 美景已被定義成只能在觀者開心時存在。
C. 景不全是慰藉，其美彷彿不在乎觀者是否需要安慰。
D. 景物為觀者量身安排，所以確保所有痛苦都消失。
boss.explain: 美與療慰效果區分，景物indifference擬人。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The return to the familiar road feels like an arrival precisely because the account has made familiarity newly perceptible.
options: A. 回熟路只因道路已實際改建成新終點才像抵達。
B. 作者從未走過此路，所以熟悉感純屬地圖錯誤。
C. 說話者認為只要熟悉，就不可能重新注意到任何細節。
D. 回熟路反像抵達，正因敘述讓熟悉重新可感。
boss.explain: 經歷使舊地被重新看見，不需地理終點改變。

boss.desc: 【字彙】Iridescence describes ___.
options: A. a steady change in size caused by movement towards the viewer
B. colours that appear to shift with the angle of light or viewing
C. a dark surface that absorbs every trace of visible light
D. the repetition of a sound after it strikes a distant wall
boss.explain: iridescence虹彩隨角度變色，不是回音或透視大小。

boss.desc: 【視角】The village first appears as a pattern of roofs; only when a window opens does the narrative acquire a human scale. What changes?
options: A. The narrator ceases to use visual details and reports only measurements.
B. The window proves the roofs were not part of the village at all.
C. A distant visual arrangement becomes connected to lived activity.
D. The village’s buildings physically shrink after the window opens.
boss.explain: 由遠景形式到生活動作，人尺度是敘事焦點變化。

boss.desc: 【短文】The narrator approaches a famous viewpoint, then turns the description towards a worker mending the wall below it. The view remains visible but no longer occupies the centre. What has shifted?
options: A. The physical location of the viewpoint to a different hillside.
B. The worker’s task from repairing a wall to photographing the view.
C. The narrator’s certainty that there was never a viewpoint there.
D. The narrative’s hierarchy of attention, not the availability of the view.
boss.explain: 依敘述中心移動，不把未聚焦誤作不可見。

boss.desc: 請唸出：使熟物陌生化的清晰光線
boss.speak: an estranging clarity of light

boss.desc: 請唸出：返程中熟悉重新變得可感
boss.ans: FAMILIARITY BECOMES NEWLY PERCEPTIBLE ON THE RETURN JOURNEY
boss.speak: familiarity becomes newly perceptible on the return journey
boss.vocabId: R8:FAMILIARITY BECOMES NEWLY PERCEPTIBLE ON THE RETURN JOURNEY

boss.desc: 請拼出：使原本熟悉之物顯得陌生的感受或效果（E 開頭，12 個字母）
boss.speak: estrangement

boss.desc: 填空題：C O N _ E M _ L A _ I V E (帶有安靜沉思意味的)
boss.speak: contemplative

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The replacement is identical in the respects the supplier lists, though those may not be the respects in which the user needs identity.
options: A. 使用者需求已被逐一列入供應者的所有規格。
B. 說話者認為相同這個詞無論何時都沒有任何意義。
C. 替換品在供應者列的方面相同，卻未必是使用者需要相同的方面。
D. 替換品已保證在所有可能用途與特徵上完全相同。
boss.explain: 相同比較面向需與用途相關，may非已證不相容。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The argument for replacing it relies on a change in preference presented as though it were a failure in the object.
options: A. 物件已在測試中確定故障，所以偏好並不涉及。
B. 偏好從未變，只是物件被別人換了標籤。
C. 說話者認為偏好改變不能成為任何個人選擇的理由。
D. 換新的理由把偏好改變講得像物件失效。
boss.explain: 偏好變化與實物故障不同，不否定自由換物。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The saving is real at the point of purchase; whether it remains a saving after storage, adaptation and replacement is the question the label leaves unanswered.
options: A. 購買當下確實省，計入存放改裝替換後是否仍省則標籤未答。
B. 購買當下價格已虛報，所以不可能有任何節省。
C. 標籤已完整核算後續成本，並保證每人都省相同數額。
D. 說話者認為存放與替換不會花任何時間或資源。
boss.explain: 承認初始節省，同時限制其可外推範圍。

boss.desc: 【字彙】A gratuitous addition is one that is ___.
options: A. required for every use of the main item
B. selected only after extensive discussion by all users
C. unnecessary or lacking a relevant justification
D. automatically supplied without any possible charge
boss.explain: gratuitous不等於一定免費；在此不必要。

boss.desc: 【指涉】The review doubts whether the saving survives repeated replacement, not whether the initial price is lower. What should be examined?
options: A. Whether the label’s initial price is printed in a larger font.
B. Whether the lower initial price has been announced publicly.
C. The number of colours in which the first version is available.
D. The total pattern of cost beyond the first purchase.
boss.explain: initial lowprice被承認，爭點在後續替換累計。

boss.desc: 【短文】A community exchange praises generosity by counting how much people give away, without asking whether others can use what is given. What is missing?
options: A. The recipient’s benefit as distinct from the donor’s act of disposal.
B. A complete record of the donors’ original purchase dates.
C. A guarantee that all donated objects came from the same source.
D. The assumption that every gift must have an identical monetary value.
boss.explain: 贈與量與受贈者效益不同，不能只將清出當慷慨。

boss.desc: 請唸出：誇耀豐裕的展示
boss.speak: an ostentatious display of abundance

boss.desc: 請唸出：真實差異未必回應既有需求
boss.ans: A REAL DIFFERENCE NEED NOT ANSWER AN EXISTING NEED
boss.speak: a real difference need not answer an existing need
boss.vocabId: R8:A REAL DIFFERENCE NEED NOT ANSWER AN EXISTING NEED

boss.desc: 請拼出：能依共同尺度比較的性質（C 開頭，16 個字母）
boss.speak: commensurability

boss.desc: 填空題：R E _ U N _ A _ C Y (因重複或超出需求而多餘的狀態)
boss.speak: redundancy

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The fact narrows the field, but it does not narrow it to a single person.
options: A. 事實已唯一確定一人，只是不方便說名。
B. 事實沒有排除任何可能，所以毫無資訊。
C. 說話者認為只要不是唯一就不能縮小範圍。
D. 事實縮小範圍，尚未縮到一人。
boss.explain: 縮減候選與唯一識別不同。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The omission matters not because it proves concealment, but because the claim of completeness depends on there being no such omission.
options: A. 遺漏重要非因證明隱瞞，而因完整性主張不容有此遺漏。
B. 只要遺漏就已證明作者蓄意藏起所有資料。
C. 作者從未主張完整，所以遺漏不涉及其說法。
D. 說話者認為任何遺漏都使每件已述事實變假。
boss.explain: 反駁完整主張不等於證動機欺騙。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The final clue resolves which account is possible under the stated conditions, not whether those conditions exhaust everything that could have happened.
options: A. 說話者認為題內條件不需要被讀者考慮。
B. 最後線索確定明示條件下哪說可行，未證條件已包盡所有可能。
C. 線索證明明示條件已列出每種世界可能，所以永無其他解釋。
D. 最後線索完全無法比較題內兩個說法，因此沒有解決任何事。
boss.explain: 條件內解與條件本身完備性的邊界。

boss.desc: 【字彙】A corollary is ___.
options: A. an unrelated detail added to make an account more vivid
B. a doubt that prevents any proposition from being stated
C. a prediction made before any assumptions are specified
D. a consequence that follows from an established proposition
boss.explain: corollary隨既定命題而出的推論或結果。

boss.desc: 【指涉】The narrator challenges not the inference from the premise but the premise from which the inference proceeds. Which response addresses the challenge?
options: A. Establishing whether the starting assumption is true.
B. Showing the same deduction in a more elegant form.
C. Repeating the conclusion with greater confidence.
D. Adding details that follow only if the premise is accepted.
boss.explain: 爭點前提，不能只重推前提到結論過程。

boss.desc: 【短文】An account first proposes that a door was rarely used, then cites the absence of remembered visits as though it independently confirmed the proposal. The proposal itself was inferred from those same memories. What is the issue?
options: A. The door’s existence has been denied despite being explicitly stated in the story.
B. The supporting observation is being counted again as independent confirmation.
C. The account has compared memories from two genuinely independent groups.
D. The rarity of visits has been directly measured using a separate continuous record.
boss.explain: 同來源重算成獨立證據，非真的兩次確認。

boss.desc: 請唸出：欠缺依據地歸給他人某種動機
boss.speak: an unwarranted imputation of motive

boss.desc: 請唸出：敘述者所知未必屬角色
boss.ans: KNOWLEDGE HELD BY THE NARRATOR NEED NOT BELONG TO THE CHARACTER
boss.speak: knowledge held by the narrator need not belong to the character
boss.vocabId: R8:KNOWLEDGE HELD BY THE NARRATOR NEED NOT BELONG TO THE CHARACTER

boss.desc: 請拼出：不能合理否認或爭辯的（I 開頭，16 個字母）
boss.speak: incontrovertible

boss.desc: 填空題：I M _ U T _ T _ O N (把通常不利的行為或動機歸給他人的指稱)
boss.speak: imputation

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The rule makes the promise binding, though only within the scoring system, not as a claim about anyone’s character outside the game.
options: A. 承諾只在計分系統有拘束，不等於判斷場外人格。
B. 計分系統已被用來正式決定每位玩家場外人格。
C. 規則沒有任何約束，所以承諾完全不影響計分。
D. 說話者認為玩家一旦承諾便無權再問規則。
boss.explain: 遊戲內機制與真人人格評價界線明示。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The safeguard protects the option to decline an alliance; it does not protect the player from every strategic consequence of declining.
options: A. 說話者確認玩家根本沒有拒絕結盟的權利。
B. 保障可拒結盟，非保障拒絕後沒有任何策略後果。
C. 拒絕結盟後所有對手都必須停止正常行動。
D. 選項保障意味拒絕者自動獲得最高分。
boss.explain: 可拒與免所有策略代價不同，限遊戲規則。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The question is not whether the move is ingenious, but whether its ingenuity depends on treating a missing definition as permission to invent a convenient one after the fact.
options: A. 說話者反對玩家依明確定義設計任何策略。
B. 只要某詞沒定義，就必定只准採最不利自己的解讀。
C. 問題非這步巧不巧，而是是否靠事後替缺漏定義挑有利解。
D. 巧妙已保證定義在行動前寫得完整清楚。
boss.explain: 創意與利用事後定義權區分，不禁止所有巧思。

boss.desc: 【字彙】To adjudicate a dispute is to ___.
options: A. make an authoritative decision about the contested issue
B. repeat both positions without reaching any judgement
C. postpone the issue until no participants remain
D. change the subject so that no dispute is mentioned
boss.explain: adjudicate裁決，遊戲情境非實際法律服務。

boss.desc: 【文法】So narrow is the exception that invoking it ___ alter the ordinary rule.
options: A. have not materially
B. does not materially
C. do not material
D. not materially does
boss.explain: invokingit動名詞單數，does not +原形alter。

boss.desc: 【短文】A rule gives the losing player the right to define what counts as losing. It is described as a safeguard against unfair defeat. What needs scrutiny?
options: A. Whether the losing player has received fewer tokens than the winner.
B. Whether defining a term always requires agreement outside the game.
C. Whether control over the classification empties the scoring constraint of force.
D. Whether any safeguard can be described without using a negative word.
boss.explain: 控制輸的定義可掏空規則拘束，非單純詞彙爭議。

boss.desc: 請唸出：有裁量空間卻仍有理由的判斷
boss.speak: a discretionary but reasoned judgement

boss.desc: 請唸出：共同許可可能需僅一方有的資源
boss.ans: A SHARED PERMISSION MAY REQUIRE RESOURCES ONLY ONE PLAYER POSSESSES
boss.speak: a shared permission may require resources only one player possesses
boss.vocabId: R8:A SHARED PERMISSION MAY REQUIRE RESOURCES ONLY ONE PLAYER POSSESSES

boss.desc: 請拼出：缺乏一致理由而恣意決定的性質（A 開頭，13 個字母）
boss.speak: arbitrariness

boss.desc: 填空題：E N F _ R C E _ B I _ I T Y (某約定可由規則要求履行的程度)
boss.speak: enforceability

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The voice is intimate, but intimacy should not be mistaken for an absence of selection.
options: A. 說話者認為所有親密敘述都不值得傾聽。
B. 聲音親密，不等於沒有取捨。
C. 只要語氣親密，每項記憶就已全被說出。
D. 親密已被證明只是錄音機製造的假聲。
boss.explain: 親密感與選材完整性分開。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The interview’s apparent candour is partly produced by the interviewer’s careful choice of the moments at which to stop asking.
options: A. 受訪者拒絕說任何話，所以不存在坦誠感。
B. 說話者確認每個問題都必須問到同一長度才公平。
C. 訪談坦誠感部分來自訪談者仔細選擇何時停止追問。
D. 只要停止提問，就已保證全部事實毫無遺漏。
boss.explain: 停問點也塑造呈現，不是全無引導的直接流出。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: A voice can remain recognisably the speaker’s while the arrangement of that voice has become unmistakably the editor’s argument.
options: A. 只要保留本人聲音，剪接就不可能形成另一種論點。
B. 編輯已改用別人聲音，所以不是排列問題。
C. 說話者主張任何錄音都不得被分段呈現。
D. 聲音仍可辨是本人，但其排列已成編輯的論點。
boss.explain: 素材真實與編排論證權分開，非必換人冒聲。

boss.desc: 【字彙】Verisimilitude is ___.
options: A. the exact chronological order of a written record
B. an appearance of truth or lifelike plausibility
C. independent verification of every reported detail
D. a refusal to imitate any recognisable experience
boss.explain: verisimilitude逼真可信感，非已查實。

boss.desc: 【指涉】The objection concerns making the speaker’s hesitation evidence of dishonesty, not preserving hesitation in the record. Which response addresses it?
options: A. Declare every hesitation proof of deception in advance.
B. Rewrite the answer to make it sound more certain.
C. Retain the pause while avoiding an unsupported judgement about its cause.
D. Remove every pause so no reader can interpret one.
boss.explain: 保存資料與賦因果動機的界線，不需抹除資料。

boss.desc: 【短文】An interview includes a contradiction. One editor removes it to protect the speaker’s dignity; another keeps it with context explaining the different moments of recollection. What does the second approach preserve?
options: A. A claim that every contradictory statement must be equally accurate.
B. The assumption that dignity requires concealing every revision.
C. A guarantee that no audience member will form an unfavourable view.
D. The complexity of the remembering process without reducing it to a simple personal defect.
boss.explain: 可保留矛盾與脈絡，不以缺陷標籤化也不保證所有人解讀。

boss.desc: 請唸出：經仔細呈現安排的回憶
boss.speak: a carefully mediated recollection

boss.ans: PRESERVING COMPLEXITY NEED NOT DIMINISH THE SPEAKER'S DIGNITY
boss.speak: preserving complexity need not diminish the speaker's dignity
